statement: à peine allongés à la fructification
family: G before or after a stage
sketch: Bearer inflorescence (raceme), the attribute length, the stage of the change (PO fruiting stage) and its degree ('à peine' = scarcely) in RDF. OWL can say at most that the inflorescence at fruiting is not elongated compared with flowering. A bare stage qualifier (kind A) plus 'elongated' as a shape would misread the statement, so only the record is safe.

statement: often to 2(-3, in sapling shoots) cm caudate
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Leaf apex caudate (PATO:0001880) goes into OWL. The length of the tail (≤ 2 cm, extreme 3 cm in sapling shoots, frequency 'often') goes into the record as a measurement of the feature the shape word names. PO has no acumen/cauda class, so the length cannot be put on a part.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Bearer pinna, the division quality (cut PATO:0001978, i.e. incised), and the depth as the distance left between the sinus and the landmark (costa, 1–2 mm) or as a fraction. OWL keeps 'pinna incised'; the depth is a measurement in the record, with the costa as landmark.

statement: with palea, or without significant palea
family: F optional part
sketch: Record the part (palea, inside the basal sterile floret) as variably present: record only in RDF, with both readings. No OWL class, since 'present or absent' is true of every plant.

family: E part present at a position
sketch: Adventitious roots present on the stem at the nodes. OWL: has part some (root and attached to some (stem node PO:0020141 and part of some stem)). The record keeps 'rooting at the nodes' as its cue.

family: dimension counted in cells
sketch: Bearer: the apiculus of the moss leaf apex. Attribute: length measured in cells, 1–2, with unit 'cell'. OWL as length with magnitude and a cell-count unit, or record only until a unit exists. A FLOPO anatomy class for the leaf apiculus may be needed (PO has only palea apiculus).

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Bearer: the abaxial corolla lobe. Landmark: the other (lateral) lobes of the 4+1 limb. Quality offset PATO:0002436 towards the lateral lobes in OWL, with the distance 3.5–7 mm (PATO distance PATO:0000040) as a measurement in the record.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: Map the habit noun to its EQ meaning through a reviewed table: liana → whole plant climbing (FLOPO:0991108) and woody. The bound 'to 12 m' is a separate pattern-02 measurement of the whole plant.

family: F optional part
sketch: 'lenticellate or not' = lenticels (PO:0000031) present or absent on branches and branchlets: record only in RDF, marked variable. No OWL class, since the union is a tautology.

family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: anther with the position inner FLOPO:0991378 (pattern 18). Qualities: decreased size PATO:0000587 and 'paler', each towards an anther with the position outer FLOPO:0991379. OWL: has part some (anther and has position some inner and has characteristic some (decreased size and towards some (anther and has position some outer))). The words stay in RDF.

statement: basal acroscopic veinlet reaching bottom of sinus
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Bearer: the basal acroscopic veinlet of the segment (position basal plus a side word 'acroscopic'). Quality: the end of the vein lies at a landmark of the same organ (the base of the sinus between segments): position towards the landmark. The basiscopic veinlet, which reaches the margin above the sinus, is the same construction. This needs a sinus class, so keep it in RDF until one is added.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Same as P00032 in the earlier review. OWL: filament exserted PATO:0000623 (towards the corolla). RDF: the length of the projecting portion, 5.5-6.5 mm, with the cue 'exserted', not stored as the filament length.

statement: some reduced to dark pectinate-serrate spines
family: other, one or two cases each
sketch: Two leaf forms coexist on one plant, so this is not an alternative at taxon level. OWL: two existential restrictions, has part some (leaf lamina and has characteristic some spine-like/reduced) and has part some (leaf lamina and has characteristic some foliaceous). This stays in EL. RDF: a shared 'dimorphic' cue links the two records and 'some'/'others' are kept as words.

statement: proximal cauline mostly withering by flowering
family: G before or after a stage
sketch: Bearer: cauline leaf PO:0000013 with the position lower ('proximal', pattern 18). Quality: senescent PATO:0001487 (withered). Stage relation: by the flowering stage PO:0007616. Frequency: 'mostly'. OWL holds the quality only; RDF holds fb:beforeStage or fb:byStage.

statement: rarely reaches a height of more than 3 feet
family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: Whole plant height: usual maximum 3 ft, converted to 0.91 m (source_unit kept), with the frequency 'rarely' attached to exceeding it. RDF: fb:high 0.91 m, fb:exceedFrequency 'rarely'. OWL: no strict bound, because some plants exceed it.

family: dimension counted in cells
sketch: Bearer: leaf margin (the moss leaf part). Quality: width, value 1, unit 'cell' (a count of cell rows), approximately ('about'), extending to mid-leaf. RDF keeps the unit 'cells'. OWL uses width with a count-type unit.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: 'Liane' becomes whole plant climbing FLOPO:0991108 plus woody. 'Herbe volubile' becomes herbaceous plus twining (see P00071). The two are alternatives (pattern 07) over operands that are habit nouns. Each habit noun needs a reviewed EQ signature.

family: position of greatest width
sketch: Bearer: leaf lamina PO:0020039. RDF: fb:widestAt with the cue 'upper 1/3' as the relative interval 0.67-1.0 of the length from the base. OWL: no new value. A class such as 'widest above the middle' could be added later as a parent of obovate and oblanceolate.

family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: Bearer: spike (inflorescence branch), not the whole inflorescence. Length with a usual minimum of 10 cm, and 'rarely' attached to falling below it. RDF only: fb:low 10 cm, fb:undershootFrequency 'rarely'. No OWL bound.

statement: les supérieures étant les plus longues
proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer calyx tooth with has position upper FLOPO:0991376 (pattern 18), and increased length PATO:0000573 towards calyx tooth, where the second term is the other members of the same series. The superlative cue 'les plus longues' goes in RDF; 'subégales' (subequal) is a separate record.

family: nested alternatives
sketch: one_of operands on the same bearer (central = terminal leaflet), each with its own bearer_scope: glabrous, or the adaxial surface (leaf lamina adaxial epidermis by slot 1) appressed-puberulent. In OWL, a union of the two defining properties (has characteristic some glabrous, or has part some (adaxial epidermis and has characteristic some puberulent)). In RDF, per-operand scope and cue.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: the bearer (petal PO:0009032), the quality of attachment (connate FLOPO:0991067) and a measured extent (length 1.2-1.4 cm of the connate portion). OWL: has part some (petal and has characteristic some connate), plus the length of a 'connate region' part of the corolla. PO has no corolla tube, so the extent needs that region class, or stays in RDF as fb:low/fb:high on the connate record. The same pattern covers 'divided 1/3 of the way', 'lobed to the middle'.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: leaf lamina lobe PO:0025517 with position basal (from 'near base'). Quality: decreased size PATO:0000587 towards some leaf lamina lobe, the other lobes of the same lamina. OWL cannot say 'of the same leaf', so the class states towards leaf lamina lobe and the record flags the target as implied (fb:towardsImplied true, cue 'smaller').

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Bearer: the region of the lamina just below (proximal to) the fertile spike, as part of the lamina and adjacent to the spike. Quality: constricted PATO:0001847, with 'somewhat' as value_qualifier approximately. OWL: has part some (lamina and has part some (region and adjacent to some spike) and has characteristic some constricted). RDF keeps the landmark and the cue 'below the spike'.

family: G before or after a stage
sketch: Bearer: cauline leaf with the position lower ('proximal', pattern 18). Quality: senescent PATO:0001487 (withered). Stage relation: by the flowering stage PO:0007616. OWL holds the quality only; RDF holds fb:byStage.

statement: Subshrubs to more than 1.5 m high
family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: Whole plant height whose maximum exceeds 1.5 m: RDF fb:maxAtLeast 1.5 m, with the cue 'to more than'. OWL carries no data range, because the statement bounds the largest plants, not every plant. 'Subshrubs' is a separate habit record.

proposed: description by reference to another part
family: reference to another part (similar to)
sketch: Bearer: sepal of the female flower (pattern 12). The statement says its qualities are those of the sepal of the male flower. Represent it by copying the reviewed records of the referenced bearer to this bearer, each with fb:derivedByReference to the source record and the cue 'semblables à ceux des fleurs ♂'. OWL gets the copied classes only; 'similar' itself has no PATO term.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: abaxial surface of the leaf blade (leaf lamina abaxial epidermis PO:0000049, slot 1). Colour: decreased saturation or increased brightness, towards the adaxial surface ('upper surface dark green' in the previous clause). OWL with towards; the cue 'paler' and the implied term go in RDF.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Two records. (1) Leaf apex acuminate (pattern 00), 'shortly' as a qualifier. (2) The length of the acumen at most 1 cm: bearer acumen (the drawn-out tip, part of the leaf apex), length with an inclusive upper bound of 1 cm (pattern 02 on that bearer). The acumen needs a FLOPO anatomy class or a pinned region.

statement: margins revolute to mid leaf or beyond
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Bearer: leaf margin. Quality: revolute PATO:0001963 over the region from the base to the middle of the leaf or beyond. RDF: fb:extentTo 'mid leaf', with the 'or beyond' cue. OWL: has part some (leaf margin and has part some (proximal region) and has characteristic some revolute), the extent stays in RDF.

family: position of greatest width
sketch: Bearer: costa (leaf midvein of the moss leaf). Its greatest width lies at the middle of the leaf. RDF: fb:widestAt 'midleaf'. OWL: has part some (costa and has characteristic some (width and widest at some middle region)) once a value for the position of greatest width exists.

statement: ribs apically prolonged into a tooth
family: E part present at a position
sketch: Slots: the part present (tooth), the host part (rib of the achene), the region (apex). OWL: has part some (rib and part of some achene and has part some (apical region and has part some tooth)). RDF: record with fb:bearer rib, fb:presentPart tooth, fb:region apex.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Slots: bearer (cauline leaf, FLOPO:0991117 position), relative quality (decreased size), and an implied target resolved from the previous clause (the basal leaves). OWL: has part some (leaf and has position some cauline and has characteristic some (decreased size and towards some (leaf and has position some basal))). RDF: fb:towards plus fb:targetResolvedFrom with the cue offsets.

statement: to more than 30 cm tall at fruiting
family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: Slots: dimension, bound on the largest value (lower bound 30 cm, strict), stage (at fruiting, in the table). RDF only: fb:maxLow 30, fb:maxLowExclusive true. No OWL class, because not every plant is over 30 cm.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: The bearer is leaf lamina abaxial epidermis PO:0000049 ('below'), with increased lightness towards the adaxial side ('above', the clause before). OWL: has part some (leaf lamina abaxial epidermis and has characteristic some (increased lightness and towards some leaf lamina adaxial epidermis)).

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: As P00232: abaxial epidermis with increased lightness towards the adaxial epidermis. The adaxial colour (tinged gray-blue) is stated in the previous clause.

statement: short shoots bear flowers and rarely reach more than 18 inches (46 cm) long
family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: Slots: bearer (short shoot, fertile), usual upper bound 46 cm (converted from 18 in), frequency of exceeding it 'rarely'. RDF: fb:high 46 with fb:usualBound and the cue. No OWL class, because the bound is exceeded. The bearer should be short shoot, not branch.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: bearer stamen, quality distance PATO:0000040 towards the landmark (corolla base, PO corolla tube base region), magnitude 2-3.1 mm. The relative form '0.3-0.4 of tube length' is a ratio to another part (pattern 10) kept in RDF only. OWL: has part some (stamen and has characteristic some (distance and towards some corolla tube)); the numbers stay in the record.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: bearer leaf base (decurrent PATO:0001984), plus a length of the decurrent part (the wing running down the stem) 3-20 mm. OWL: leaf base has characteristic some decurrent; the extent is in RDF as a measurement of the decurrent wing (length PATO:0000122), or OWL with a FLOPO 'decurrent leaf base wing' part. The source clause is a three-way alternative (pattern 07) of decurrent 3-20 mm, clasping and decurrent 1-3 mm, and not decurrent.

statement: sepals reddish or the inner subpetaloid
family: nested alternatives
sketch: Slots: two operands with different bearers: (sepal, reddish) or (inner sepal [FLOPO inner FLOPO:0991378 via pattern 18], petaloid FLOPO:0991141, approximately for 'sub-'). OWL: the taxon has phenotype some (P1 or P2), where P1 and P2 are the two phene classes. Pattern 07 only allows unions over values of one bearer.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: Give the held growth-form classes an EQ signature instead of rule kind flopo_phenotype_class. FLOPO_0985032 'vine' = has part some (whole plant and has characteristic some climbing FLOPO:0991108); 'liana' FLOPO_0900035 = climbing and ligneous; twining FLOPO_0985034 = a twining child of climbing. 'woody' is then a second statement, ligneous.

statement: nervura-marginal hasta 1 mm de distancia de la margen(es)/entre 1 y 2 mm de distancia de la margen(es)
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: bearer leaf lamina intramarginal vein PO:0025520 ('nervura-marginal' needs a bearer rule), quality distance PATO:0000040 towards leaf margin, range given as alternatives '≤1 mm / 1-2 mm' (union, i.e. up to 2 mm). OWL: has part some (intramarginal vein and has characteristic some (distance and towards some leaf lamina margin)); numbers in the record.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: bearer costule, quality distance PATO:0000040 towards the adjacent costule (same class), upper bound 8 mm (pattern 02 bound). OWL: has part some (costule and has characteristic some (distance and towards some costule)); the number in the record.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: As P00253: give twining FLOPO_0985034 an EQ signature, whole plant has characteristic some twining (a child of climbing FLOPO:0991108). 'Deciduous' (PATO deciduous (plant)) and 'shrubs' (frutescent) are separate statements.

family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: Slots: bearer peduncle, length, maximum ≥ 20 cm (the largest values exceed 20 cm). This is not a range of the usual values. RDF: fb:maxAtLeast 20 with the unit and cue 'to more than'. OWL: no class (it says nothing of every peduncle), as for extremes in pattern 05.

statement: subtended on one side by a phalloid nectary
family: E part present at a position
sketch: Slots: the part (extrafloral nectary PO:0009057, shape 'phalloid' in RDF), the place (base of pedicel, on one side), relation 'subtends'/adjacent to. OWL: has part some (extrafloral nectary and 'adjacent to' some pedicel). 'characteristic of ser. Laxiflorae' is taxonomy and not annotated.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: bearer petal, quality split PATO:0001786 (bifid at the apex), depth of the incision 0.5-1.5 mm. OWL: petal has characteristic some split; the depth is a length of the cleft region in RDF (or ratio of the petal length, as in 'divided 1/3').

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: As P00253: define whole plant lianescent FLOPO_0900035 as climbing FLOPO:0991108 and ligneous. 'Shrub, Liana' is then an alternative of two habit classes (pattern 07).

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: As P00253/P00277: the French 'Lianes' should reach the defined liana class (climbing and ligneous). 'ligneuses' repeats ligneous.

family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Read "the upper" as the bearer's own noun (glume) with position upper FLOPO:0991376; the bearer gets position lower FLOPO:0991377 (pattern 18). OWL: has part some (glume and has position some lower and has characteristic some ('decreased width' PATO:0000599 and towards some (glume and has position some upper))). Relax relation_target_is_not_the_bearer when the two positions differ.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer should be the lateral lobe of the catkin scale (lobe with position lateral FLOPO:0991380), not the scale. The quality is increased width PATO:0000600 towards the central lobe named earlier in the clause. OWL as pattern 09 with towards some (lobe and has position some median FLOPO:0991381). The record keeps the bare "broader" as comparison_text.

family: nested alternatives
sketch: One range whose attribute is the union of height PATO:0000119 and length PATO:0000122, both 1-D extent PATO:0001708. OWL: has characteristic some ((height or length) and has magnitude some xsd:decimal[>=0.03, <=0.25]), with the extreme 0.4 in RDF (pattern 05). The bearer is the whole plant (erect or creeping shoot).

family: nested alternatives
sketch: The ocrea surface (bearer stipule PO:0020041; "surface" unscoped) is glabrous PATO:0000451 or a continuum from appressed-pubescent to spreading-pubescent. OWL: union of glabrous and pubescent. The appressed-to-spreading continuum is a reified qualitative_value_relation in RDF only.

family: E part present at a position
sketch: Read the fixed phrase "rooting at the nodes" as presence of roots at the stem nodes. OWL: has part some (root PO:0009005 and attached to some 'shoot axis node' PO:0005004). The record keeps the process wording as its cue.

statement: with or without long, stiff hairs near sinuses
family: F optional part
sketch: Record trichomes (long, stiff) near the sinuses of the corolla lobes as present with frequency 'sometimes', in RDF only. In OWL, present-or-absent is trivial, so no class (or only the class for the 'with' alternative, flagged non-universal).

statement: dorsal sepal and petal position in relation to column porrect/dorsal sepal porrect/petal more recurved than sepal dorsal
proposed: comparison of degree with another part
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Petal recurved PATO:0002211 towards the dorsal sepal (sepal with position dorsal), with "more ... than" kept in RDF as comparison_text. OWL keeps the quality and the second part (as pattern 09), since PATO has no increased-degree form of a curvature.

statement: petioles up to 4 cm. long or longer
family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: Record the usual maximum 4 cm in RDF with an open max extreme ("or longer"). OWL gets no numeric restriction (the bound is not a bound) beyond petiole length.

family: other, one or two cases each
sketch: Style inserted into PATO:0000624 towards ovary, with the region of the ovary as a filler: towards some (ovary and part of ... apical region). The subapical-to-apical continuum is in RDF. Pattern 09 now keeps the region only in comparison_text, and the target (ovary) is implied.

family: G before or after a stage
sketch: Valve PO:0025228 coiled PATO:0000404 (synonym spiral), with a stage relation 'after' fruit dehiscence. The model has present_during only, so add an 'after' relation to a PO stage. "persistent" is a separate statement.

proposed: comparison with an implicit second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: leaf lamina abaxial epidermis (slot 1, 'beneath'). Quality: a lighter colour 'towards' the implied counterpart, the adaxial epidermis, which comes from a table of opposite places (beneath/above, inner/outer). OWL: has part some (abaxial epidermis and has characteristic some (light and towards some adaxial epidermis)). RDF: fb:implicitTerm true.

statement: base covered by remnant fibrous sheaths
family: E part present at a position
sketch: Bearer: stem base. A carried part: leaf sheath with the qualities fibrous and persistent. OWL: has part some (stem base and has part some (leaf sheath and has characteristic some fibrous and has characteristic some persistent)). RDF: fb:bearer stem base, fb:carriedPart leaf sheath, with the qualities of the carried part.

statement: insérées à 0,3–0,7 de la longueur du tube
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: OWL: stamen inserted into (PATO:0000624) towards corolla tube (pattern 09). RDF only: the insertion point as 0.3-0.7 of the tube length from the base, as fb:low/fb:high with unit 'ratio' and fb:reference corolla tube length.

statement: Flowers opening at same time or before leaves
family: G before or after a stage
sketch: Slots: an event of the bearer (flowering, from 'opening'), a relation (before | simultaneous with), and a reference stage (leaf expansion). RDF: fb:event, fb:relation, fb:relativeTo the PO stage. OWL: a union of synanthous and proteranthous (precocious) phenotype values once such values exist.

family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: Slots: an uncertain maximum given as a range (1-3 mm), with no lower bound. RDF: fb:maxLow 1, fb:maxHigh 3, unit mm. OWL: only the safe bound, length some float[<= 3] mm.

statement: terminal leaflet usually rather broader than the laterals
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: The bearer is leaflet with 'has position' terminal (PATO:0002476). Its quality is increased width towards some (leaflet and 'has position' some lateral). In OWL: has part some (leaflet and has position some terminal and has characteristic some (increased width and towards some (leaflet and has position some lateral))). 'Usually' and 'rather' stay in RDF.

family: G before or after a stage
sketch: Pedicel PO:0030112 descending FLOPO:0991207 (rule R0326 'declined'), with a developmental-stage context whose relation is 'after' the anthesis stage instead of present_during. 'Early' is a timing cue that stays in RDF. In OWL, only the stage-bounded quality goes into the class, as for 'in fruit'.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Bracteole PO:0009043 split PATO:0001786. The depth of the split is a length of 5-8 mm on the cleft region: has part some (bracteole and has characteristic some split and has part some (cleft region and has characteristic some (length and has magnitude 5-8 and has value unit mm))). 'Unilaterally' is a lateral position cue. Fractions ('divided 1/3') would use the same slot with a ratio unit.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Style PO:0009074 exserted PATO:0000623 towards the perianth (corolla or petals). The length of the projecting portion (1-1.4 mm) is a measurement of the part of the style outside it, held in the record as fb:low/fb:high with the exserted value. The class carries exserted towards the enclosing part.

family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Anther PO:0009066 part of an inner stamen (inner FLOPO:0991378), decreased size towards some anther of an outer stamen (outer FLOPO:0991379). The second term ('outer anthers') comes from the preceding clause. 'Paler' is the same construction with colour.

family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Petal PO:0009032 with 'has position' anterior: decreased length towards some (petal and not anterior), which in practice means the lateral and upper petals. 'Conspicuously' stays in RDF. Use the same form as for the terminal and lateral leaflets.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Stigma PO:0009073 exserted PATO:0000623 towards the corolla tube, with an upper bound of 10 mm on the projecting length (pattern 02 cue 'up to'). 'Reaching the corolla mouth or' is the first alternative (pattern 07). The class carries exserted, and the distance stays in the record.

statement: bracteoles and sepals similar to those of male flowers but slightly smaller
family: other, one or two cases each
sketch: Derive records for the bracteoles and sepals of the female flower (pattern 12) by copying the qualities stated for the male-flower parts, with provenance pointing to the source statements. Add 'smaller' as decreased size PATO:0000587 towards the same part of the male flower; this needs a towards-target that is part of a qualified whole. OWL holds the copied qualities; the copying link stays in RDF.

statement: crenate or crenate-serrate or rarely subentire
family: nested alternatives
sketch: This needs a one_of union with three operands: crenate (scalloped PATO:0001889), crenate-serrate as a continuum scalloped–serrated (PATO:0001206), and 'subentire' as entire PATO:0104359 with value_qualifier approximately, carrying frequency 'rarely' (pattern 08). OWL: has characteristic some (scalloped or serrated or entire). The continuum and the frequency stay in RDF.

family: E part present at a position
sketch: 'rooting at nodes' → adventitious roots present at the stem nodes: a record with bearer adventitious root, quality present PATO:0000467, and position landmark stem node. OWL: has part some (stem node and has part some adventitious root). 'at least basally' is a region qualifier that stays in RDF. 'creeping' FLOPO:0991009, whose definition already includes rooting at the nodes, is annotated separately.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: Use a table of habit nouns (es 'bejuco' = liana) mapping each to an EQ signature: whole plant PO:0000003 climbing FLOPO:0991108, together with woody stem. OWL: the intersection of the two defining properties. 'ramificado' (branched) and 'arbustivo' (frutescent habit FLOPO:0987002) are separate statements.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Major veins with a relational colour quality (paler, i.e. lighter than) towards an implied comparand: the leaf lamina, taken from a table of default comparands per bearer. 'below' places the veins on the abaxial side (slot 1). OWL uses the towards slot as in pattern 09; the implied target is marked as inferred in RDF.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: upper leaf (named positioned part, pattern 18) with decreased size PATO:0000587 towards leaf PO:0025034 of the lower series (the implied term). The following 'gradually reduced ... upward' is a gradient that confirms the reading and is kept in RDF.

statement: en nombre égal à celui des carpelles
proposed: count equal to that of another part
family: counts relative to something
sketch: stigma has number of PATO:0001555 towards carpel, ratio 1, cue 'en nombre égal à celui des'. EL cannot state the equality, so it stays an RDF record (as in pattern 14). An optional derived OWL range of 2–5 can be copied from the carpel count, with provenance.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: Same as P00424: 'bejucos' → whole plant PO:0000003 climbing FLOPO:0991108 plus woody stem, from the habit-noun table.

family: counts relative to something
sketch: inflorescence branchiness PATO:0002009 with an order of branching 1–3 (has magnitude 1–3, count unit) as a FLOPO measure of branching order. OWL takes the data range, as in pattern 17.

proposed: description by reference to another part
family: reference to another part (similar to)
sketch: Record only: bearer lip, fb:towards petal, and the cue 'similar to'. No OWL class, because similarity says nothing that can be checked. The shapes in parentheses ('narrowly obovate-spatulate') should be annotated on the lip by pattern 00/07, and that carries the content.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: Add a reviewed table from habit noun to whole plant PO:0000003 plus values: liane/liana → climbing FLOPO:0991108 and woody. OWL is the intersection of the value restrictions on the whole plant, and the record keeps the noun as cue. 'À extrémités velues' is a separate record (shoot tips hairy).

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: the two lateral veins of the bract/stipule (position lateral FLOPO:0991380, count 2). Quality: decreased thickness PATO:0000592 towards the other veins of the same organ, taken from the clause ('more salient' nerves). OWL uses 'towards' some vein; the record keeps the cue 'thinner'.

proposed: description by reference to another part
family: reference to another part (similar to)
sketch: Record only: bearer bracteole PO:0009043, fb:towards bract, cue 'similar to'. No OWL class. The explicit colour and length that follow are annotated by pattern 00.

family: dimension counted in cells
sketch: Bearer: leaf margin (limbidium), quality thickness PATO:0000915, 4–5 with unit 'cell layers' and frequency 'mostly'. OWL is a data range on thickness with a FLOPO unit 'cell' (not UO). Alternatively a count of cell layers that are part of the margin.

family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: 'To over 2 m' says that the tallest plants exceed 2 m: a lower bound on the maximum height. Record: fb:maxAtLeast 2 m on whole plant height PATO:0000119. OWL gets only 'has characteristic some height', because no closed data range follows.

proposed: description by reference to another part
family: reference to another part (similar to)
sketch: Implied target: the preceding member of the series, upper glume ('papery'). Record: bearer lemma with position lower (FLOPO:0991377), fb:towards upper glume, cue 'similar'. The alternative 'rarely coriaceous' is pattern 08.

family: other, one or two cases each
sketch: Bearer anther, quality pilose (hairy), with a distribution of the hairs in 2 longitudinal lines. Representation: a count of hair-line regions (part of anther, 'has characteristic' pilose) or a FLOPO value 'lineate indument' plus a count in the record. Annotate 'dorsally puberulent' separately (kind C).

family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: "to at least 1.5 cm" says that the largest fruit seen reaches at least 1.5 cm. It is not a lower bound for every fruit. RDF: a record with fb:maxAtLeast 1.5 cm, the cue "to at least" and the bearer state immature (pattern 04). OWL: only the existential `has part some (fruit and has characteristic some (length and has magnitude some xsd:decimal[>= 1.5]))`, which is true of the plant.

statement: common to a depth of 4 inches
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Depth of the rhizome below the soil surface: PATO depth (PATO:0001595) or distance (PATO:0000040), measured from a landmark that is not a plant part (the soil surface), with the usual range 2.5-5 cm and the extreme 'common to 10 cm' in RDF. OWL: `has part some (rhizome and has characteristic some (depth and towards some 'soil surface'))` once an ENVO landmark is allowed; until then a record only.

statement: exserted up to 2 mm beyond anthers
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: A relational quality with a measured extent: exserted (PATO:0000623) towards anther, with the distance by which it projects as an upper bound of 2 mm. OWL: `has part some (style and has characteristic some (exserted and towards some anther))`. RDF: the record adds fb:high 2, unit mm and a property marking it as the extent of the relation.

family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: "To over 60 cm": the largest leaves exceed 60 cm. RDF: fb:maxAtLeast 60, strict, with the cue "to over". OWL: only `has part some (leaf and has characteristic some (length and has magnitude some xsd:decimal[> 60]))`, never a bound on all leaves.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Stamen exserted (PATO:0000623), towards the perianth or the tube when the clause names it, with the projecting length 1-2 mm. OWL: the relational quality only. RDF: fb:low 1, fb:high 2, mm, as the extent of the exsertion.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Lateral sepals (pattern 18) fused with each other (PATO:0000642 towards lateral sepal, pattern 16), with the length of the fusion 8-12 mm as the extent of the relation. OWL: `has part some (sepal and has position some lateral and has characteristic some ('fused with' and towards some sepal))`. RDF: fb:low 8, fb:high 12, mm on the record.

statement: each tooth tipped with awl-like leaf
family: E part present at a position
sketch: A part that sits at a named place of another part: leaf located at the apex of a stem tooth. OWL: `has part some (leaf and 'part of'/'located in' some (apex and 'part of' some 'stem tooth'))`, plus leaf subulate and 2-5 mm. RDF: the record with the place cue "tipped with".

family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: 'To more than 30 cm' says the largest axes exceed 30 cm, so it is a lower bound on the maximum, not an upper bound. Record: length with fb:low 30 cm and a flag that it bounds the maximum. OWL: only the presence plus the attribute; no data range, because not every axis exceeds 30 cm. The bearer is the inflorescence axis PO:0020122, not the inflorescence.

family: E part present at a position
sketch: Spikelet PO:0009051 has part an abscission zone PO:0000146 that is part of the spikelet rachilla PO:0009080, located below each fertile floret. RDF keeps the position text. OWL: has part some (abscission zone and part of some spikelet rachilla), with the position as a restriction.

proposed: comparison with an implicit second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: The abaxial lamina epidermis PO:0000049 has a lighter colour towards the adaxial epidermis, which the preceding 'green above' supplies. Fill towards from the contrasted surface of the same clause; the cue is 'paler'.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Costule (the midvein of a pinna lobe) has distance PATO:0000040 towards the same kind of part, with magnitude 5 mm. The towards slot points to the same class as the bearer.

family: E part present at a position
sketch: 'Breaking up at maturity' means the spikelet disarticulates within itself, as opposed to falling entire. Spikelet PO:0009051 has part an abscission zone PO:0000146 in the spikelet rachilla PO:0009080. The stage 'at maturity' is the bearer state mature (kind A).

family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: 'To over 1 m' is a lower bound on the maximum: height with fb:low 1 m, flagged as bounding the maximum, and no OWL data range. 'Flowering' is the stage row flowering stage PO:0007616. The measure is the height of the plant in flower, including the scape.

family: position of greatest width
sketch: The leaf lamina has a widest point located in the distal half. Record: position text, plus a FLOPO value 'widest above the middle' defined by a measure (pattern 17 style). OWL: has characteristic some that value.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: The filament (stamen PO:0009029) is exserted PATO:0000623, towards the corolla or perianth. The length of the exserted portion is about 2 mm, kept as magnitude and unit on the record. OWL: exserted only; the 2 mm stays in RDF until a 'projecting length' attribute exists.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: the bearer (petal claw, part of petal), the reference part (calyx), and the projecting length 2-5 mm with its unit. OWL: has characteristic some ('protruding out of' PATO:0001646 and towards some calyx). RDF: fb:towards plus fb:low/fb:high/fb:unit for the exserted portion, kept out of the class.

family: counts relative to something
sketch: Slots: the bearer (peduncle), the kind of branching (dichotomous), and how many orders (1-3, extreme 4), with '×' read as 'times'. OWL: peduncle has characteristic branched (dichotomously). RDF: fb:low/fb:high of the branching orders, like a count, kept out of the class.

statement: not meeting the veins of the adjacent lobes
family: other, one or two cases each
sketch: Slots: the bearer (vein of an ultimate lobe), the relation (separated from PATO:0001505), and the target, the same kind of part qualified as belonging to an adjacent lobe. The target is the bearer's own class, so the rule relation_target_is_not_the_bearer must allow it. Record it in RDF only, as OWL cannot say 'of the adjacent lobe'.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: the bearer (ovary, its top), the implied reference (hypanthium or calyx tube rim), and the height 1 mm. OWL: ovary has characteristic raised PATO:0001369. RDF: the 1 mm projection with its unit and fb:comparison 'per 1 mm elevatum'.

statement: inserted 3-4 mm above base of corolla tube
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: the bearer (filament), the relation (inserted into PATO:0000624 towards corolla tube), the landmark (base of the corolla tube), and the distance 3-4 mm. OWL: the insertion only (pattern 09). RDF: a distance PATO:0000040 record with fb:landmark and fb:low/fb:high/fb:unit.

statement: spreads by seed and also by short rhizomes and leafless stolons
proposed: process as presence of a part
family: other, one or two cases each
sketch: Map 'spreads by X', 'propagating by X' and similar to the presence of X: rhizome PO:0004542 present (with 'short'), stolon PO:0003024 present, and the stolon leafless (pattern 15). OWL: has part some rhizome; has part some stolon. Keep the process words as the cue in RDF. 'by seed' adds nothing and is dropped.

statement: à 2-4 mm du bord du limbe
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: bearer (the loops of the lateral veins / lateral vein), quality distance PATO:0000040, landmark (leaf lamina margin), magnitude 2–4 mm. OWL: has part some (lateral vein and has characteristic some (distance and towards some 'leaf lamina margin' and has magnitude 2–4 mm)). RDF: fb:towards plus fb:low/fb:high/fb:unit. The looping (brochidodromous) is a separate statement.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Slots: bearer leaf abaxial side, relative quality lighter/paler (decreased saturation or lightness), towards the adaxial side of the same leaf (taken from the contrast word 'beneath'), degree 'scarcely' kept in RDF. OWL: has part some (leaf and has part some (abaxial side and has characteristic some (paler and towards some adaxial side))).

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: tepal with position inner FLOPO:0991378 (pattern 18). Quality: decreased length PATO:0000574, towards tepal with position outer, which is implied by 'inner'. OWL: has part some (tepal and has position some inner and has characteristic some ('decreased length' and towards some (tepal and has position some outer))). The count '2' is a separate count of inner tepals.

family: dimension counted in cells
sketch: Slots: bearer (the marginal band of the lamina, in mosses), dimension (thickness PATO:0000915 or width PATO:0000921), value range, unit 'cell' (a count of cell layers or rows). OWL: has part some (bearer and has characteristic some (thickness and has magnitude some decimal[>=2,<=3] and has value unit some 'cell layer')); in RDF fb:unit is the cell-layer count. The same construction covers '2–3 cells wide'.

statement: similar but shorter, proportionately broader bracteoles
proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Slots: bearer (bracteole), relational quality (decreased length PATO:0000574, increased width), and the second term resolved from the subject of the clause (bract), with the source words as cue. Once resolved, the OWL is pattern 09: has part some (bracteole and has characteristic some ('decreased length' and towards some bract)). 'Proportionately broader' is a ratio comparison and stays in RDF.

statement: with about ten glandular dots per square milimeter
family: other, one or two cases each
sketch: Slots: counted part (gland, portion of secretory tissue PO:0005656), surface or container (leaf lamina PO:0020039), value (about 10), unit count per mm². In RDF fb:low = fb:high = 10, a per-area unit and qualifier approximately. In OWL: has part some (leaf lamina and has characteristic some (density towards some gland, with magnitude and unit)).

family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Slots: bearer (leaf with position upper FLOPO:0991376, pattern 18), relational quality (decreased size), and the implied second term: the other members of the same series (lower leaves, FLOPO:0991377). OWL: has part some ((leaf and has position some upper) and has characteristic some ('decreased size' and towards some (leaf and has position some lower))). The record keeps the cue 'smaller'.

family: G before or after a stage
sketch: Slots: bearer (leaf with position basal FLOPO:0991002, 'radical'), state (withered), and the stage it is reached before (flowering stage PO_0007616), with relation 'before' as well as present_during. OWL: the state with a stage restriction; RDF: fb:stageRelation 'before' and the cue 'early'. Neither marcescent (persists) nor fugacious (falls) is meant.

statement: Vines to more than 10 m tall
family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: 'to more than 10 m' says that the largest plants exceed 10 m, not that every plant does. In RDF: fb:maxLow 10 m (a lower bound on the maximum), with the cue. In OWL: no data range on the class (or a separate 'can reach' class), because '> 10' would be false for small plants. Bearer: whole plant, length (vines: 'tall' = length of the climbing stem).

family: position of greatest width
sketch: Record the measure 'relative position of the widest point' FLOPO:0995011 on the bearer (nut, fruit) with value about 0.4–0.6 and the cue 'broadest near the middle'. In OWL the record carries the measure as a data range, and the pattern 17 axioms classify it (elliptic, or ellipsoid for a solid). Pattern 17 states that floras never give the widest point; this statement is a counterexample.

family: F optional part
sketch: 'X absent or <description>' means 'X, when present, <description>'. Annotate the length 1-1.5 mm of the floral disc FLOPO_0986025 with the qualifier 'when present' in RDF. Claim neither presence nor absence in OWL: the union 'not has part some disc or has part some (disc and ...)' is outside EL and says little. The diameter, shape and hairs in the same clause take the same qualifier.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: the margin of the rhizome scale. Quality: a lighter (paler) colour, towards the same scale, meaning its centre (the clause later says 'center opaque'). OWL: has part some (scale margin and has characteristic some (lighter and towards some scale)). 'Sometimes' is a frequency, so the record stays in RDF.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: basal leaf cells (cells of the basal leaf region). Quality: decreased length PATO:0000574 towards the upper and median leaf cells named in the preceding clause. OWL as in pattern 09, with the target recovered from the previous member of the series.

family: other, one or two cases each
sketch: Slots: the part (flower), a process (flower opening, with the degree 'widely'), the stage (anthesis), and the frequency 'usually'. Keep it as an RDF record with the process term and no OWL class, until a quality such as 'perianth spreading at anthesis' is reviewed.

statement: Fertile florets decreasing in size upwards
family: gradient along a series
sketch: Slots: the members of a series (fertile florets), the dimension (size), the direction (decreasing towards the apex of the spikelet). OWL: has part some (spikelet and has characteristic some (decreasing size and towards some floret)), with the direction as a FLOPO value 'acropetally decreasing'. Alternatively RDF only.

family: other, one or two cases each
sketch: Slots: the part (the upper lip of the calyx), the process (splitting or slitting), and the stage (anthesis, PO_0007616 flowering stage). Keep an RDF record with the stage, and add no OWL class until a quality (for example a calyx 'splitting at anthesis' dehiscence value) is reviewed.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Split it into two records. First, leaf blade acuminate (PATO:0000222 is not needed: acuminate is PATO_0002228) with pattern 00. Second, the length of the acumen, with an upper bound of 1 cm (pattern 02). The acumen is the apical region (BSPO) of the leaf apex, carried as a part_restrictions filler. In OWL: 'has part' some (leaf lamina and 'has characteristic' some acuminate and 'has part' some (apical region and 'has characteristic' some (length and 'has magnitude' max 1 cm))). The record keeps the cue 'up to 1 cm.'.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Lenticel (PO:0000031) gets a relational lightness quality 'towards' the bark (PO:0004518). The bark is the surface named in the same clause ('pale brown bark'), and the record keeps it as an implied target with its offsets. The other words go through existing patterns: oval → elliptic PATO:0000947, raised → PATO:0001369, conspicuous → prominent.

family: nested alternatives
sketch: The flowers are borne in either of two kinds of inflorescence. OWL: 'has part' some ((inflorescence and 'has characteristic' some fascicled FLOPO:0991098) or raceme inflorescence PO:0030115), with 'dense' and 'short' as qualities of each operand. RDF: a one_of record whose operands differ in bearer class, not in value.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Abaxial leaflet surface, paler and duller 'towards' the adaxial surface. The second term is the contrasted side named in the same clause ('lustrous green above'). A fallback with existing terms: discolorous (FLOPO:0991070) on the leaflet, plus dull (FLOPO:0991106) on the abaxial epidermis (the 'beneath' surface rule).

family: nested alternatives
sketch: One bearer has two alternative sizes: 'tiny (0.2–1 mm)' or 'elongate (to 2 mm)'. Write a one_of record with two length operands (0.2–1 mm; ≤2 mm), and in OWL a union of the two magnitude restrictions. Separately, the gland-tipped bristle of a leaf tooth must not ground to the moss seta PO:0030032. Use a glandular trichome instead.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: Map a habit noun to a conjunction of whole-plant values in a reviewed table. For liana: whole plant (PO:0000003) 'has characteristic' some climbing (FLOPO:0991108) and 'has characteristic' some woody. 'to 3 m' becomes a plant height with an upper bound (pattern 02). The record keeps the noun as its cue.

statement: the ventral pair shorter and broader than the rest
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: the calyx tooth (lobe) with position ventral (pattern 18). Its qualities are decreased length and increased width 'towards' the other calyx teeth of the same calyx (members of the series not in that position). RDF: the target is the remaining members ('the rest'), not a different kind of part.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: Habit noun table: 'climber' → whole plant 'has characteristic' some climbing (FLOPO:0991108). The adjective 'woody' adds 'has characteristic' some woody on the same whole plant. Record the noun as the cue.

statement: the middle sinus sometimes to half-way towards costa
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Bearer: the sinus of the pinnule's upper edge (middle sinus, position median). Quality: depth as a ratio (0.5) of the distance from margin to costa, with frequency 'sometimes' in RDF. OWL: depth 'towards' the costa with 'has magnitude' 0.5 and unit ratio. A sibling record gives the ordinary sinus at 0.25 of the distance between the upper and lower edges.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Style 'has characteristic' some (exserted PATO_0000623 'towards' some hypanthium), using pattern 09 for the relation. Add the length of the exserted portion, 1.5 mm, as a magnitude of that relation in RDF and as a data restriction on the exserted region in OWL. Annotate the orifice and disc diameters as their own measurements.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Slots: bearer (the leaflet's abaxial epidermis, from the surface cue 'beneath'), a relational quality (high brightness / lighter colour), and the implied term, the opposite surface (adaxial epidermis). OWL: has part some (leaflet abaxial epidermis and has characteristic some (lightness and towards some leaflet adaxial epidermis)). The leaflet can also be stated discolorous (FLOPO:0991070). RDF: fb:towards with fb:implicitTarget true.

statement: deeply bifid to middle or more
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: OWL: has part some (petal limb and has characteristic some bifurcated PATO:0001784), where 'bifid' is a synonym of bifurcated. RDF: the depth as a fraction of the limb length, fb:divisionDepth low 0.5 with no upper bound, unit ratio, cue 'to middle or more'. 'or more' is an open bound, not a disjunction.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: OWL: has part some (stamen filament and has characteristic some exserted PATO:0000623). RDF: the length of the portion beyond the corolla as fb:low 4.5, fb:high 5.5, unit mm, with fb:projectionBeyond the corolla (towards). The number is not a length of the filament and stays out of the class.

family: G before or after a stage
sketch: Bearer: basal leaf FLOPO:0996000 (pattern 18). Quality: withered / wilted. Stage relation 'before' to the PO flowering stage, with frequency usually. The record carries stage_relation before plus the PO stage. The OWL class carries only the bearer and quality, or no class, as for kind A2 (the model has present_during only).

statement: branching about 3 m from the base
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: OWL: has part some (trunk/stem and has characteristic some branched PATO:0000402). RDF: fb:distance 3 m (qualifier approximately, 'about') from landmark stem base, cue 'from the base'. The distance stays out of the class.

statement: a cyme to at least 6 cm long
family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: 'to at least 6 cm' says the largest cymes reach 6 cm or more; it is neither an upper bound nor a lower bound on every cyme. Keep it as an RDF-only record: bearer inflorescence PO:0009049 with state male (pattern 04), length PATO:0000122, fb:maxAtLeast 6 cm, with the cue 'to at least'. Emit no OWL class, because neither 'length >= 6' nor 'length <= 6' holds of every cyme.

statement: the lateral broader than the dorsal
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: The second term is given ('the dorsal' ribs). Both terms are ribs of the fruit that differ in position. Bearer: fruit rib with position lateral FLOPO:0991380 (pattern 18). Quality: increased width PATO:0000600 towards a fruit rib with a dorsal position, which needs a 'dorsal' position value. OWL: has part some (rib and has position some lateral and has characteristic some (increased width and towards some (rib and has position some dorsal))).

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Bearers anther PO:0009066 and style, quality exserted PATO:0000623 towards the perianth (pattern 09). The 10 mm is the length of the projecting portion: a measurement of distance PATO:0000040 with magnitude 10 mm on the same relation. OWL: exserted and towards some perianth; the distance goes as a data range on the relational quality.

statement: branched at bases or proximal to middles
family: nested alternatives
sketch: The quality (stem branched PATO:0000402) is certain; only where branching starts is an alternative (at the base, or below the middle). OWL: stem and has characteristic some branched. The union of the two regions (basal region / proximal half) is a filler of part_restrictions. The region cues and the 'or' stay in RDF.

family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: The implied second term is the terminal panicles of the same clause. Bearer: inflorescence PO:0009049 with axillary FLOPO:0991000. Quality: decreased length PATO:0000574 towards an inflorescence with a terminal position. Resolve the second term to the other member of the series named in the clause.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Bearer: pinna segment. Quality: distance PATO:0000040 towards an adjacent segment (same kind), 2-3 mm. OWL: has part some (segment and has characteristic some (distance and towards some segment and magnitude 2-3 mm)). The transcribed 'length' is wrong.

family: G before or after a stage
sketch: Bearer pedicel PO:0030112, value drooping PATO:0002165 (nodding). Add a temporal slot with relation 'after' and the stage anthesis (a PO stage). The current model has present_during only. In OWL the value holds during a post-anthesis stage, and the cue 'after anthesis' goes in RDF.

proposed: comparison with an implicit second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Take the second term from the preceding clause (filaments, stamen filament). Then this is pattern 09: anther PO:0009066, decreased length PATO:0000574 towards filament. Record the resolved antecedent and its offsets as the target cue.

family: counts relative to something
sketch: Bearer tooth with container leaf margin PO:0020128. Quality: amount per unit length, 5-7 teeth per cm (a density, with unit count/cm). RDF only (fb:low, fb:high, fb:unit 'per cm'). No OWL class, as for counts at a position.

statement: midrib and main lateral veins distinctly paler
proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer leaf midvein PO:0020139 (and a second record for the main lateral veins), with a relational lightness quality (paler, i.e. increased lightness) towards the implied second term, leaf lamina PO:0020039. Veins compared in colour default to the lamina they lie in. Keep 'distinctly' and the implicitness of the target in RDF. In OWL: has part some (leaf midvein and has characteristic some (paler and towards some leaf lamina)).

family: E part present at a position
sketch: Slots: the part (lip callus), the host (lip: lower petal FLOPO:0996024, narrow synonym labellum) and the region of the host (base, a pinned BSPO basal region). OWL: has part some (lower petal and has part some (basal region and has part some lip callus)). The orchid lip callus needs a FLOPO anatomy class: PO plant callus PO:0005052 is undifferentiated tissue and FLOPO floret callus FLOPO:0986120 is the grass floret callus, so both are wrong. 'small' and 'bilobed' are separate records of the callus.

statement: inferior lemma similar to the superior glume
proposed: description by reference to another part
family: reference to another part (similar to)
sketch: Bearer lower lemma FLOPO:0996027, with a 'similar to' link to upper glume PO:0006004 in RDF (fb:similarTo). There is no OWL class, because 'similar' does not say which qualities are shared. A later step could copy the target's annotated qualities, as review status. 'male' belongs to the lower floret, not the lemma.

family: E part present at a position
sketch: Slots: the part, anther theca appendage FLOPO:0986131 (spur), present on the lower anther locule. The region is the base of the locule (pinned BSPO basal region). OWL: has part some (anther locule and has part some (basal region and has part some 'anther theca appendage')). 'blanc' and '0,5 mm' are separate records of the appendage.

statement: margins ciliolate or subglabrous near apex
family: nested alternatives
sketch: one_of on the bract margin with two operands: ciliolate, or glabrous (approximately, 'sub-') with a bearer_scope of the apical region ('near apex', slot 1). OWL: a union of the two defining properties. RDF: per-operand scope and cue.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer midrib, a relative quality (lighter colour, i.e. increased brightness) 'towards' an implied part; here the lamina, the part that contains it. RDF records the implied target with a flag fb:impliedTarget and a rule for resolving it (containing part, series sibling, previous subject). OWL: only when the target is resolved; otherwise RDF only.

statement: Basal leaves usually shed by anthesis
family: G before or after a stage
sketch: Bearer basal leaf (position basal, pattern 18), quality absent or deciduous (PATO:0001730), with a stage relation 'by' (before the end of) the PO flowering stage. RDF: fb:stageRelation 'before' and fb:stage, with 'usually' as frequency. OWL: none until the model has before/after relations beyond present_during.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer uppermost stem leaf (position upper), decreased size 'towards' the implied lower and median stem leaves of the same series. RDF records the implied target; OWL only when it is resolved.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer bracteole, decreased size 'towards' the bract, resolved from the previous clause's subject ('similar but somewhat smaller'). The rule takes the preceding subject when the clause begins 'similar'; 'somewhat' is a weak-degree qualifier in RDF.

statement: surfaces somewhat to more often strongly dissimilar
proposed: comparison between sides of one part
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: A quality 'dissimilar' (differing in colour and indumentum) of the leaflet towards its own opposite surface: leaflet abaxial epidermis has characteristic (dissimilar towards leaflet adaxial epidermis), with the degree 'somewhat to strongly' in RDF only. The following abaxial/adaxial colour statements carry the concrete values.

statement: 1,5–2 mm au-dessus de la base des lobes

proposed: comparison with an implicit second term

statement: covered by alternating series of woolly bracts and persistent swollen truncated leaf bases

family: B lower bound on the maximum

statement: joined for 2-4 mm at the base

family: nested alternatives

RDF: fb:landmark, fb:low/fb:high, fb:unit.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Bearer anther PO:0009066, exserted PATO:0000623, and distance PATO:0000040 towards the corolla throat (landmark), 0-0.88 mm. OWL and RDF as for P01029. A lower bound of 0 means 'just reaching the throat', so the value exserted should be kept out of the class when the lower bound is 0.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term

family: gradient along a series
sketch: Bearer: bracts as a series along the inflorescence axis. Quality: size decreasing in the distal direction (a decreased-size gradient towards the distal members). family: F optional part
sketch: Bearer: cauline leaf (FLOPO cauline FLOPO:0991117, pattern 18). The one_of has operands 'few' (indefinite count, pattern 13) and absence (pattern 15). OWL: (not has part some (part of some cauline leaf)) or (has part some (cauline leaf ...few)). RDF: one_of with one negated operand.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: laminal cells at the leaf insertion (basal region, slot 1). Quality: increased width towards the other laminal cells (implied). In OWL the target is the laminal cell with another position; the RDF marks the target as implied. 'Slightly' is a degree qualifier in RDF only.

statement: with pubescence denser on principal veins
proposed: comparison between regions of one part
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart

OWL: has part some (leaf vein and part of some leaf and has characteristic some ('increased density' and towards some leaf lamina)); RDF keeps 'denser on principal veins' as the comparison words. Meanwhile, 'veins pubescent' can be emitted with slot 1 (region 'on the veins').

proposed: comparison between regions of one part
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Slots: bearer leaf sheath, region margin (BSPO margin / PO margin), quality low saturation or high brightness (pale PATO:0000328 / light PATO:0000203) towards the rest of the sheath. OWL: has part some (margin and part of some leaf sheath and has characteristic some ('high brightness' and towards some leaf sheath)); RDF keeps 'paler'. 'dark brown' is annotated separately (pattern 00).

family: reference to another part (similar to)
sketch: Slots: bearer (bracteole), antecedent part (bract) and the statements of the antecedent in the same clause. Representation: copy the antecedent's grounded records (persistent, ovate base, filiform apex) to the bearer as derived records with fb:derivedBy 'similar to' and status review; no OWL 'similar' relation, since PATO has none.

family: other, one or two cases each
sketch: Slots: bearer floret, quality angle PATO:0002326 (or divergent), target rachilla (implicit axis), magnitude 45, unit degree (UO:0000185). OWL: has part some (floret and has characteristic some (angle and towards some rachilla and has magnitude 45 and has value unit degree)); RDF: fb:towards, fb:low/high 45, unit degree.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: Map the habit noun 'liane/liana' to whole plant PO:0000003 with two qualities: climbing FLOPO:0991108 and ligneous PATO:0002348. Give FLOPO_0900035 'whole plant lianescent' the signature has part some (whole plant and has characteristic some climbing and has characteristic some ligneous) so that the annotator can link it.

statement: petiole with rhachis to ± 50 cm. long
family: other, one or two cases each
sketch: Slots: two parts (petiole PO:0020038, leaf rachis) measured together, quality length, upper bound 50 cm, approximately. Record only (fb:bearer petiole, fb:alsoBearer rachis, fb:combined true); no OWL class, because neither part alone has the length. The cue 'to ±' must also be read (patterns 02 + 01).

family: F optional part
sketch: Union of absence (pattern 15) and presence with qualities: not (has part some (part of some branch)) or has part some (branch and has characteristic some short and has characteristic some slender). Record: one_of operands, the first negated with scope absence. Bearer: moss stem branch (the moss PO parts).

family: E part present at a position
sketch: Slots: the part implied by the process (adventitious root), the landmark (stem node PO:0020141), present. OWL: has part some (adventitious root and attached to some stem node), or pattern 09 'attached to' PATO:0001667 towards stem node; RDF keeps 'rooting at nodes'. A table maps process words (rooting at → adventitious root) to their part.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: bearer verticillaster, quality distance PATO:0000040 towards verticillaster (the same kind), 3-30 mm. OWL: has part some (verticillaster and has characteristic some (distance and towards some verticillaster and has magnitude ...)); RDF fb:towards, low/high, unit.

statement: to at least 23.5 cm on juvenile plants
family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: 'to at least 23.5 cm' says the maximum is ≥ 23.5 cm: record fb:maxAtLeast 23.5 cm with the bearer state juvenile (pattern 04); no OWL class (not a bound on every plant).

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: As for P01087: liana → whole plant climbing FLOPO:0991108 and ligneous PATO:0002348, via an entity–quality signature on FLOPO_0900035. The list 'Arbusto, trepadora, liana' is an alternative (pattern 07) of habit-noun operands.

family: A comparison with an implied counterpart

family: counts relative to something

The OWL side would be at most a derived mean seed mass (mass of a seed = 1/count). Otherwise no class, because a seed-lot figure includes how the seed was cleaned.

family: dimension counted in cells

family: other, one or two cases each

proposed: comparison with an implied second term

family: nested alternatives
sketch: Union of oblong with the continuum cordate (PATO:0000948 heart shaped) to deltoid (PATO:0001875 triangular). In OWL: has characteristic some (oblong or heart shaped or triangular). family: dimension counted in cells
sketch: A thickness (or width) measured in cell layers: the bearer is the marginal band of the lamina (leaf margin), the quality is thickness, and the unit is 'cell' (a count unit, not UO). family: A comparison with an implied counterpart

proposed: comparison with an implied second term

statement: lacunae in 2--5 rows each side midrib

statement: convex and drying slightly darker below

sketch: Slots: bearer (primary lateral vein), relational quality (darker colour), comparand resolved by rule from the context (the lamina tissue around it on the same surface), and surface (abaxial, slot 1). In OWL: has part some (vein and has characteristic some (darker and towards some lamina)), only when the rule resolves the comparand. In RDF: fb:towards plus fb:comparandImplied true. Here 'drying' also makes it a specimen-condition record (pattern 06), so it stays RDF-only. 'convex below' annotates separately.

family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: marginal lamina cells (with 'in several rows'). Quality: decreased size and smoothness, towards the implied comparand: the median/inner lamina cells described just before. Same representation as P01326. The thicker, coloured walls go to the cell wall as bearer.

family: dimension counted in cells
sketch: Slots: bearer (leaf auricle / alar region), dimension (width PATO:0000921), value range, unit 'cell' (number of cell rows across). In RDF: fb:low/high with fb:unitSymbol 'cells'. In OWL: a data range with has value unit some a FLOPO 'cell-row count unit'. 'sometimes' is a frequency and stays in the record. The transcribed entity 'leaf margin cell' should be the auricle.

family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: 'to more than X' and 'to at least X' say that the largest plants exceed X, not that every plant does. In RDF only: fb:maxAtLeast X with unit and the cue. No OWL class: neither 'height > 30 cm' nor '≤ 30 cm' holds of every plant (as in pattern 14). Height of whole plant, 30 cm.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: Add a reviewed table: habit noun → (whole plant PO:0000003, value). vine/climber/liana/twiner → climbing FLOPO:0991108 (twiner → twining); herb → herbaceous; subshrub → semi-woody FLOPO:0991309. FLOPO_0985031/0985032 get that EQ signature. 'woody' annotates whole plant woody as a separate statement.

statement: the tuber to at least 6 cm diam.
family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: As P01338: tuber PO:0025522 diameter, fb:maxAtLeast 6 cm, RDF only.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: bearer (stigma), landmark (corolla, or its apex), distance range and unit. In OWL: has part some (stigma and has characteristic some (exserted PATO:0000623 and towards some corolla)). In RDF: also a distance PATO:0000040 measurement 1-2 mm with fb:landmark corolla.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: As P01340: 'climber' → whole plant climbing FLOPO:0991108 (FLOPO_0985031 gets that signature), 'woody' → whole plant woody. 'to 5 m high' is a supported upper bound for height.

statement: persis-tantes sur des noeuds inférieurs défeuillés
family: E part present at a position
sketch: Slots: part (inflorescence), place (lower stem node), quality of the place (leafless). In OWL: has part some (inflorescence and part of some (stem node and has characteristic some leafless)). In RDF: fb:bearer inflorescence, fb:place stem node, fb:placeQuality. The whole statement is an alternative with 'axillary' (pattern 07).

family: E part present at a position
sketch: 'rhizomes rooting at the nodes' is the presence of shoot-borne (adventitious) roots at the rhizome nodes. In OWL: has part some (rhizome and has part some (node and has part some adventitious root)). In RDF: bearer adventitious root, fb:place node, container rhizome.

statement: incisas hasta 1.5-2 mm de la costa
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: bearer (pinna), division quality (incised), depth given as the distance of the sinus base from a landmark (costa) or as a fraction of the half-width. In OWL: pinna has characteristic incised. In RDF: a distance PATO:0000040 of 1.5-2 mm with fb:landmark costa, or a fraction for 'divided 1/3'.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: As P01340: herb → herbaceous, subshrub → semi-woody FLOPO:0991309, 'basally woody' → woody at the base (slot 1 region). Then the union over the two habits (pattern 07). Note that '1 - 1.5 mm tall' is a source error for m.

family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: As P01338: height fb:maxAtLeast 5 m, RDF only. 'Climbers' → habit-noun (whole plant climbing); 'dioecious' separately.

family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Slots: bearer, relative quality, and an implied target taken from the same series or from the other surface or region of the same organ, with the cue. OWL: has part some (bract and has position some upper FLOPO_0991376 and has characteristic some (decreased size PATO:0000587 and towards some (bract and has position some lower))). RDF: fb:towards plus a flag that the target is implied, not stated.

family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: leaf lamina abaxial epidermis PO:0000049. Quality: a 'paler' (higher lightness) value under color brightness PATO:0000016, towards the adaxial epidermis, which is implied by 'light green above' in the same clause. Store the implied target in RDF. In OWL use towards the adaxial epidermis, or else colour green on the abaxial epidermis only.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: bearer (filament PO:0009067), relational or positional quality (exserted PATO:0000623), and the length of the portion of the bearer that has the quality (low, high, unit). OWL: has part some (filament and has part some (portion and has characteristic some exserted and has characteristic some (length [1.5, 1.8] cm))). RDF: the extent as fb:low/fb:high/fb:unit on the record, with the relation word kept.

statement: costa ending 3-5 cells before the tip
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: bearer (moss costa PO:0030072), quality distance PATO:0000040 towards a landmark (apex of the non-vascular leaf), and a value with its unit (here 3-5 cells, a count unit). OWL: has part some (costa and has characteristic some (distance and towards some 'non-vascular leaf apex')). The numbers go in RDF as for measurements. 'ending' is not a process.

statement: 3-4 per diagonal row across midstem segment
family: counts relative to something
sketch: Slots: counted part (areole), group (a row of areoles: an object aggregate with has member areole), and the organ the group lies on (cladode PO:0025354, the midstem segment). OWL: has part some (cladode and has part some (aggregate and has member some areole and has characteristic some (amount [3, 4] count))). The 'diagonal row' wording stays in RDF.

family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: the margin (border) region of the phyllary, involucral bract PO:0009045. Quality: paler, towards the central part of the same phyllary (implied). The colour words that follow ('membranous-whitish green') can be annotated on the border as plain colour and texture (pattern 00).

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: The styles, taken as a set, are connate (pattern 16, connate FLOPO:0991067), and the length of the fused portion is 0.5 mm. OWL: the set with has characteristic some (connate towards style) and has part some (fused portion and has characteristic some (length 0.5 mm)). RDF: the extent as low/high/unit with 'joined for'.

family: other, one or two cases each
sketch: Slots: bearer part (fruit PO:0009001), process (dispersal by animals, from GO or a reviewed FLOPO term), cue. OWL: 'has part' some (fruit and 'has disposition' some <dispersal by animal>). RDF: fb:bearer, plus an fb:process link instead of fb:quality.

family: other, one or two cases each
sketch: Slots: bearer part, surface (inside -> adaxial, slot 1), marking kind (spot), colour of the marking. OWL: 'has part' some (inflorescence bract and 'has characteristic' some spotted PATO:0000333 and 'has part' some (spot and 'has characteristic' some purplish red)). RDF: fb:bearer, plus fb:marking and fb:markingColour.

family: E part present at a position
sketch: Slots: the present part (shoot-borne root PO:0000042), the bearer (stem PO:0009047), the place (stem node PO:0020141), cue. OWL: 'has part' some (stem and 'has part' some (stem node and 'has part' some shoot-borne root)). RDF: presence record with fb:bearer and fb:place.

statement: basal acroscopic veinlet reaching bottom of sinus
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: bearer (basal acroscopic veinlet; secondary leaf vein PO:0020140 with position), landmark (bottom of the sinus between segments), cue 'reaching'. OWL: 'has part' some (vein and 'has characteristic' some (position and towards some sinus)). RDF: fb:towards plus fb:extentText.

statement: style exserted 0.2–1.3 mm beyond orifice of beak
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: bearer (style), quality exserted PATO:0000623, magnitude 0.2-1.3 mm, landmark (orifice of the perigynium beak). OWL: 'has part' some (style and 'has characteristic' some (exserted and towards some <beak>)), with distance PATO:0000040 carrying the magnitude. RDF: fb:towards, fb:low/high, fb:unit.

family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: 'to more than 10 X 3 cm' sets a lower bound on the largest blades. It does not bound all blades, so it cannot be a pattern 02 bound. Keep it as an RDF-only record: length with fb:maxAtLeast 10 cm and width with fb:maxAtLeast 3 cm, a strict bound, with the cue 'to more than'. Do not write an OWL class, because a range class would be false for the ordinary leaves.

statement: stamens ca. 2 mm above base of corolla tube
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Record the stamen with PATO distance (PATO:0000040), 'towards' the base of the corolla tube, about 2 mm (pattern 01 for 'ca.'). The OWL is has part some (stamen and has characteristic some (distance and towards some corolla tube base and has magnitude 2 mm)). 'Pin flowers:' is the whole that the stamens belong to (pattern 12) with a long-styled morph quality, which has no term yet. 'Thrum flowers with positions reciprocal' is a separate statement and is not annotated.

family: other, one or two cases each
sketch: The bearer is trichome PO:0000282 with the organ (fruit) as bearer_container, the same slot pattern 03 uses for counts. The quality is length 0.5 mm. The OWL is has part some (trichome and part of some fruit and has characteristic some (length and has magnitude 0.5 mm)); the RDF uses fb:bearer trichome and fb:container fruit. The transcription should give the bearer as hair, not use 'hairs' as the quality.

family: other, one or two cases each
sketch: Rattan floras give the stem diameter 'with' and 'without' leaf-sheaths. Keep the stem as bearer and add a record-level condition (fb:measuredWith leaf sheath, cue 'with'), like specimen condition (pattern 06), with no OWL class. Otherwise 1 cm would contradict 0.7 cm. Accept 'to ±' as an upper bound with approximation (pattern 02 + 01).

family: other, one or two cases each
sketch: The same as P01456. The bearer is trichome PO:0000282 with container petiole (and branchlet). Length 2-4 mm; spreading, reddish and hispid are further qualities of the trichome. 'Hairs or setae' are synonyms of trichome in PO, not alternatives.

family: other, one or two cases each
sketch: The same as P01456. The bearer is trichome PO:0000282 with container inflorescence axis (the brachyblast), length 0.1-0.2 mm.

statement: anterior(es) dimensiones menor que los posterior(es)
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: The bearer is a style with position anterior (pattern 18) and the second term is a style with position posterior. The OWL is has part some (style and has position some anterior and has characteristic some (decreased size and towards some (style and has position some posterior))). Pattern 09 rejects a second term of the bearer's own class, so it needs this extension and the position values anterior and posterior.

statement: Perianth open, whitish to yellowish, with green or brownish dorsal stripe or tip; tepals 5–8 mm. long, 2–3 mm. wide, 3-veined.
family: nested alternatives
sketch: The union is over (bearer, value) pairs: the dorsal stripe of the tepal (its midvein region, slot 1) or the tepal apex, each green or brownish. The OWL is has part some ((tepal region1 and has characteristic some (green or brown)) or (tepal apex and has characteristic some (green or brown))). The main colour 'whitish to yellowish' is a separate continuum statement.

statement: young thinner and papyraceous when dry
proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Split the clause. 'papyraceous when dry' is leaf lamina + papyraceous PATO_0104010 with state young (pattern 04) and specimen condition dried (pattern 06). 'thinner' is decreased thickness 'towards' the same part in the contrasted state (mature lamina, taken from the preceding 'coriaceous'). The implied term is recorded in RDF (fb:towards, fb:comparisonImplicit), and there is no OWL class until the counterpart is grounded.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Style + branched PATO_0000402 in OWL. In RDF, the place of division is relative to another part: fb:landmark anther, fb:landmarkRelation 'at level of' with fraction 0.5 ('mid-anther'), and its cue. The landmark stays in RDF only, like pattern 14's place, because it is a relative level, not a part of the style.

family: reference to another part (similar to)
sketch: Record bracteole fb:resembles bract with the cue. Derive copies of the bract's qualities in the same taxon (lanceolate, white-hispid) as derived records with status review. No OWL class for 'similar' itself, only for the derived records once accepted.
