statement: erect or obliquely spreading to subsquarrose
family: nested alternatives
sketch: value_operator one_of with operands erect (PATO) and a continuum operand: spreading (obliquely) to squarrose FLOPO:0991237 approximately ('sub-'). OWL: has characteristic some (erect or spreading or squarrose). RDF: operands, the second a qualitative_value_relation. Bearer: female bract (pattern 12, 'Gynoecia').

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: The bearer is the infructescence cells (bracteoles/valves), with quality distance PATO:0000040 'towards' some part of the same kind, and low 0.3, high 0.5 mm. In OWL: has part some (X and has characteristic some (distance and towards some X)), with the numbers in the RDF record. 'gap' is not a bearer.

family: nested alternatives
sketch: Allow an operand of one_of to be a conjunction of values of one bearer. The bearer is leaf base: acute, or (obtuse and decurrent with 'short'). In OWL: leaf base and (has characteristic some acute or (has characteristic some obtuse and has characteristic some decurrent)). The bearer is the base (slot 1 region), not the blade.

family: gradient along a series
sketch: The leaves become denser (more crowded) toward the stem apex. Make it a quality of the stem's leaf arrangement (crowded) at the apical region, or an increasing density along the stem's proximal-distal axis. In OWL: stem and has part some (apical region and has characteristic some crowded), keeping the gradient wording in the RDF record.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: With a place word, the implied second term is the opposite side: 'paler beneath' = the leaf abaxial surface is lighter 'towards' the adaxial surface. Record bearer, quality, the implied target and how it was inferred. In OWL: has part some (abaxial epidermis and has characteristic some (decreased saturation/lighter and towards some adaxial epidermis)).

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: The second term is the reference of the earlier 'similar to middle stem leaves': the upper stem leaf blade is decreased in size 'towards' the middle stem leaf blade. Carry the reference from the clause before. In OWL: leaf lamina with position upper, has characteristic some (decreased size and towards some (leaf lamina with position median)).

family: nested alternatives
sketch: Each operand of one_of is a conjunction of a shape and a size of the same bearer: (ovoid and diameter 8 mm) or (globose and diameter 10 mm). In OWL: union of intersections of has characteristic restrictions on fruit, with the numbers in the RDF record. For a 3-D fruit, 'orbicular' should be globose/spherical, not the 2-D orbicular.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: As 'paler beneath': 'paler ... on the under surface' means the leaflet's abaxial surface is lighter 'towards' its adaxial surface ('glaucous above' gives the other side). Same slots and OWL as P01548.

family: dimension counted in cells
sketch: Bearer: the apiculus of the moss leaf apex. PO has only palea apiculus, so a FLOPO anatomy class may be needed. Attribute: length 1-2 in the unit 'cell', recorded only in RDF until a cell-count unit exists. The 'celled → locule' row of flora_counted_parts.tsv must not fire here.

family: E part present at a position
sketch: Adventitious roots present at the stem nodes, and only at the lower nodes (position lower FLOPO_0991377 on the node, pattern 18). OWL: has part some (root and attached to some (stem node and has position some lower)). The record keeps 'rooting at the lower nodes' as its cue.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: OWL: ligule of the outer florets (position outer FLOPO_0991379) exserted PATO_0000623, towards the involucre. RDF: the length of the projecting part, 7-10 mm, with 'exserted' as cue. It is not stored as the ligule length.

family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: 'narrower, smaller than stem leaves' shares one 'than' term, so both comparatives point to the stem leaves. Bearer: leaf part of some branch. Qualities decreased width and decreased size, each towards (leaf part of some main stem). Pattern 09 must accept a target of the bearer's class when the two are told apart by their whole or position.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: OWL: anther exserted PATO_0000623, towards the perianth. RDF: the projecting length 1-4 mm, with 'exserted' as cue. It is not stored as the anther length.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer bracteole, quality decreased size PATO_0000587, towards bract: the part described in the clause just before ('Bractées ... longues de 2-3 mm'). The target is resolved from the preceding clause of the same sentence, with its offsets as cue. OWL then has the normal pattern-09 form.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: Give the liana class FLOPO_0900035 'whole plant lianescent' an EQ signature: whole plant climbing FLOPO_0991108 and woody. Map 'Liane/liana' to it through a reviewed habit-noun table. Today 'liana' is only a synonym of whole plant in po_lexicon.tsv.

statement: Vines to more than 10 m tall
family: C growth-form noun
sketch: Give FLOPO_0985032 'whole plant vine phenotype' an EQ signature: whole plant climbing FLOPO_0991108. Map 'vine(s)' to it. 'to more than 10 m tall' is a separate record: a lower bound on the maximum height, RDF only.

statement: adaxially pilose or only on midvein
family: nested alternatives
sketch: A union of two operands with different scopes: leaf blade adaxial epidermis pilose (substituted bearer), or pilose only on the adaxial side of the midvein. OWL: has part some (adaxial epidermis and pilose) or has part some (midvein and pilose). The exclusive 'only', meaning the rest is glabrous, stays in RDF.

proposed: description by reference to another part
family: reference to another part (similar to)
sketch: Copy the reviewed colour records of the petiole to the peduncle, each with fb:derivedByReference to the source record and the cue 'colored as petiole'. OWL gets only the copied classes. '20-60 cm' and the diameter are separate pattern-00 measurements.

family: G before or after a stage
sketch: Bearer: basal leaf (position basal, pattern 18), withered, after a stage. 'soon' is read as early, usually by flowering. RDF: the stage relation (after or by anthesis) with the cue 'soon withering'. OWL: only the bearer, since withering is a change over time and not a state of every plant.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: OWL: median sepal (position median, pattern 18) saccate FLOPO_0991140, read from 'sac-like hood'. RDF: the depth of the hood, 10-16 mm, as a measurement of the feature the shape word names. PO has no hood or galea class to carry it.

statement: cleft dorsally to a point 4-5.5 mm. from the base
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Bearer corolla tube, quality split PATO:0001786 on the dorsal side; OWL keeps 'corolla tube split'. In RDF, the depth is the distance from the corolla base (landmark) to the end of the cleft, 4–5.5 mm, length PATO:0000122.

family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: Bearer trichome PO:0000282 on the young shoots, not the whole plant. The value is length with usual maximum 0.5 mm and fb:exceedFrequency 'rarely'. RDF only, with no OWL bound. The appressed/ascending orientation and 'puberulent' are separate records.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Bearer: the ovary lobes (the apical carpel lobes of the Aizoaceae ovary; no PO class). Quality raised PATO:0001369 in OWL on the ovary. In RDF, the height by which the lobes stand above the ovary top is 1 mm, with the ovary top as landmark.

family: G before or after a stage
sketch: Bearer leaf (trophophore). In RDF, the events are leaf emergence and leaf death, with their seasons ('midspring', 'early fall') as qualifiers. PO stages have no seasons. In OWL, at most leaf deciduous (generic) PATO:0001730, since the leaves die each autumn.

family: F optional part
sketch: 'petiole absent or to 1.2 cm' means: when the petiole is present, its length is ≤ 1.2 cm. Record the petiole of the basal leaves with the bound (pattern 02) and the qualifier 'when present' in RDF. Write no OWL presence or absence, since the union with absence is outside EL.

statement: if present, then never equalling or exceeding the calyces
family: F optional part
sketch: When present, the bracteole PO:0009055 is shorter than the calyx: decreased length PATO:0000574 towards calyx PO:0009060 (pattern 09), with 'when present' in RDF. 'never equalling or exceeding' is the cue. Write no OWL presence or absence. 'absent from pedicels' gives the place, pedicel.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: Use a reviewed habit-noun table: liane → whole plant climbing FLOPO:0991108 (rule R0234 already says this for 'liane'). Alternatively, give the FLOPO lianescent/climber whole-plant class the EQ signature 'whole plant and has characteristic some climbing', so the class resolves. 'ligneuse' is a separate record: whole plant ligneous.

statement: midrib plane to slightly raised or slightly impressed above
family: nested alternatives
sketch: Bearer midrib (primary leaf vein) on the adaxial side ('above', slot 1). Values: a continuum flat PATO:0000407 → raised PATO:0001369 (slightly), or sunken PATO:0002416 (slightly impressed). In RDF, a one_of whose first operand is a qualitative_value_relation. In OWL, the union of the three values.

family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: Petiolule PO:0020050 length with an uncertain maximum given as a range: RDF fb:maxLow 1, fb:maxHigh 1.5 cm. OWL holds only the safe bound, length ≤ 1.5 cm.

family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: Whole plant height whose maximum is at least 0.4 m: RDF fb:maxAtLeast 0.4 m with the cue 'to at least'. No OWL data range, because the statement bounds the tallest plants, not every plant. 'Dwarf shrub' is a separate habit record.

statement: paler, hardened and thickened in the upper 1.5–2 mm.
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Bearer filament PO:0009067, not stamen. Its distal region has the qualities increased thickness PATO:0000591, hardened, and paler (a comparison with the rest of the filament, implied second term). In OWL: filament has part some (distal region and has characteristic some increased thickness). In RDF, the extent of the region is 1.5–2 mm from the apex.

family: counts relative to something
sketch: Slots: the counted part (ray flower PO:0025331), quality amount PATO:0000070, and the reference part (bract/phyllary) whose count is given in the clause before. RDF: fb:countEqualTo the reference part, with the reference count copied (about 15) and value_qualifier approximately. OWL: presence of ray flowers in the head only, as in pattern 13, because the equality is to another statement's number.

proposed: comparison with an implicit second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer petal with position inner FLOPO:0991378 (pattern 18); quality decreased size towards petal with the opposite position in the series (outer), which comes from the series pair inner/outer and is not stated in the text. RDF: fb:towards petal plus fb:towardsPosition outer and fb:towardsImplied true. OWL: as pattern 09 with the target 'petal and has position some outer'.

family: other, one or two cases each
sketch: Slots: the bearer (petal), the division value (split, the PATO 'split' parent used by laciniate/pedate), and the measured depth of the incision with its unit. RDF: fb:divisionDepth with low 1.0, high 2.5, unit mm. OWL: 'has part some (petal and has characteristic some split)', with the depth as a data range only once a 'depth of incision' attribute exists.

family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: the secondary bract (bract with a series-position value). Quality: decreased size PATO:0000587 towards (RO:0002503) the primary bract of the preceding clause. 'semblables' copies the primary bract's qualities and stays in RDF only. OWL: has part some (bract and has position some secondary and has characteristic some (decreased size and towards some (bract and has position some primary))).

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Keep the state as an ordinary value: spathe, decurrent PATO:0001984. A second slot measures the extent of the region in that state: a length (0.5-)1-1.5(-2) cm of the decurrent part, with extremes as in pattern 05. OWL: has part some (spathe and has characteristic some decurrent and has part some (region and has characteristic some length [magnitude])).

family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: sepal with position inner FLOPO:0991378. Quality: decreased width PATO:0000599 towards the sepal with position outer FLOPO:0991379, taken from the previous clause ('outer 3 sepals').

family: nested alternatives
sketch: A union over bearer classes rather than values: has part some (raceme inflorescence PO:0030115 or panicle inflorescence PO:0030123). 'short' and 'reduced' are qualities of the respective operand. RDF: one record with fb:bearer per operand and value_operator one_of over bearers.

family: other, one or two cases each
sketch: Bearer: male spikelet (pattern 04 state male). Quality: deciduous towards (RO:0002503) the fertile (female) spikelet, meaning they are shed as one unit. RDF records the partner part and the cue 'with the fertile'.

family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: bract with position upper FLOPO:0991376. Two qualities, decreased size PATO:0000587 and a lesser degree of division, each towards the bract of the lower part of the raceme, which the previous clause describes ('blade deeply biternatisect').

proposed: comparison between sides of one part
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: the abaxial epidermis of the leaf lamina (slot 1, 'below'). Quality: a lighter colour (increased lightness) towards the adaxial epidermis of the same leaf, which carries the explicit colour 'dark green above'.

family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: sepal with position lateral FLOPO:0991380. Quality: decreased width PATO:0000599 towards the dorsal sepal of the previous sentence. 'similar' (copying the dorsal sepal's qualities) stays in RDF only.

statement: Stamens inserted at 0.6-0.9 mm from corolla base
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Bearer: stamen, with 'inserted into' PATO:0000624 towards the corolla tube. A measurement of distance PATO:0000040, 0.6-0.9 mm, from the corolla base as landmark. The fraction '0.2-0.3 of tube length' is a ratio record (unit ratio) to the tube length.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Bearer: the longer stamens (filament), exserted PATO:0000623, towards the perianth. A second slot gives the length of the exserted portion, 5-7.5 mm.

family: counts relative to something
sketch: Slots: the axis (inflorescence rachis), the mode of division (dichotomous = bifurcated PATO:0001784) and the number of successive orders (4-7). OWL: has part some (rachis and has characteristic some bifurcated and has characteristic some ('number of branching orders' and has magnitude some decimal[>=4,<=7])). This needs a FLOPO attribute under amount; the same pattern serves '2-3-pinnatisect'.

statement: both surfaces pubescent or only abaxially
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: the bearer, the quality and alternative surface scopes (both surfaces | abaxial only). OWL keeps the part common to all alternatives as firm (leaf lamina abaxial epidermis pubescent). The adaxial side is the union (adaxial epidermis pubescent or glabrous), or stays in RDF as the alternative scopes with their cues.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: A habit noun names the whole plant together with its habit qualities. A reviewed table maps each noun to PO:0000003 plus qualities: liana/liane → climbing FLOPO:0991108 + woody, vine → climbing. OWL: has part some ('whole plant' and has characteristic some climbing and has characteristic some woody). 'parfois' (sometimes) goes in the RDF frequency.

statement: basal and proximal cauline usually withering before flowering
family: G before or after a stage
sketch: Slots: the bearer (basal and proximal cauline leaves, pattern 18), the quality (withered) and a stage relation (before | after) to a PO stage (flowering stage PO:0007616) with its cue. The OWL class has the bearer and quality only; the 'before' relation and 'usually' stay in RDF, since the model has present_during only.

family: gradient along a series
sketch: Slots: the series (phyllaries of the involucre), the attribute (size), the direction (decreasing outward) and its cue. OWL as a quality of the whole towards its parts (pattern 16): involucre has characteristic some (graduated towards some phyllary), with a FLOPO value 'graduated' under size. The direction and 'gradually' stay in RDF.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: As P01735: vine → whole plant climbing FLOPO:0991108. The explicit 'climbing' and 'woody' give whole plant climbing and whole plant woody. 'High' is a relative height and stays in RDF.

family: other, one or two cases each
sketch: Slots: the sub-part (lamina, blade), the named whole it belongs to (staminode), and the measurement (length about 2 mm, width about 2.5 mm, approximate per pattern 01). OWL: has part some (lamina and part of some staminode and has characteristic some length ...). The record gives the whole in fb:container.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: A reviewed table maps a habit noun to the whole plant plus its qualities: liana -> whole plant with climbing (FLOPO:0991108) and a woody stem; vine -> whole plant with climbing. OWL: has part some (whole plant and has characteristic some climbing ...). Modifiers ('élevée', '20-40 m') become separate statements.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: vine -> whole plant with climbing (FLOPO:0991108), from the habit-noun table. 'Deciduous' becomes a separate statement: whole plant with deciduous (plant) PATO:0001731.

family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Slots: the bearer, the comparative quality (paler, i.e. lighter colour) and an implied target resolved from the clause, here the lamina whose colour was just stated. OWL: has characteristic some (light/decreased saturation and towards some leaf lamina). The record flags the target as implicit (fb:impliedTarget).

family: counts relative to something
sketch: The state of the bearer is a count of its parts: the fruit with 1 seed (has number of = 1). That state restricts the shape (round). OWL: has part some (fruit and has characteristic some (has number of towards seed, magnitude 1) and has characteristic some round). The record gives the state in fb:bearerState.

family: dimension counted in cells
sketch: A width or thickness of a moss structure measured in cell rows ('border 1 cell wide', 'costa 2 cells thick'). Slots: the bearer (leaf border), the attribute (width), the number and the unit 'cell row', and a region ('in the upper part of the leaf'). OWL: has characteristic some (width and has magnitude 1 cell row), with a FLOPO unit because UO has none.

statement: with one or two teeth or cilia
family: nested alternatives
sketch: Count 1-2 of a union of parts on the ventral leaf margin: 'has part' some ((tooth or trichome) and 'part of' some ventral margin), with the bounds on that count. In RDF, two fb:bearer values plus fb:bearerOperator one_of.

family: E part present at a position
sketch: The statement is the presence of shoot-borne roots (PO:0000042) at the stem nodes of the basal region: 'has part' some ('shoot-borne root' and 'part of'/attached to some (stem node and 'part of' some basal region of stem)). In RDF: bearer the root, plus the container and the position.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: A reviewed table splits each habit noun into (whole plant, value) pairs, which become an intersection in OWL. 'vine' becomes whole plant + climbing (FLOPO:0991108); 'herbaceous' is a second value. Where a named FLOPO habit class exists, link it as fb:flopoClass.

statement: with or without a small linear basal bract
family: F optional part
sketch: State no presence in OWL, because 'present or absent' is a tautology. Mark the record fb:presence 'variable'. The qualities of the part when present (small, linear, basal) stay in RDF with the scope 'when present'.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: Split 'climbing shrub' into whole plant + climbing (FLOPO:0991108) and whole plant + shrubby/frutescent, written as an intersection in OWL. Link the FLOPO habit class as fb:flopoClass.

family: gradient along a series
sketch: Bearer: involucral bracts. Quality: length, with an fb:gradient 'decreasing' along the series (outer to inner). OWL can only state 'has member' some bract per position; the gradient stays in RDF until there are position-indexed members.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: Use a reviewed table from habit noun to whole plant (PO:0000003) plus its qualities. Liana = climbing (FLOPO:0991108) and woody, written in OWL as an intersection of has_characteristic restrictions on the whole plant, with the noun kept as the cue in RDF. 'Woody' needs a term: none was found in the PATO lexicon. FLOPO_0900035 'whole plant lianescent' would then get this EQ signature.

family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: Record that the largest rhizomes and stems exceed 50 cm (RDF: fb:maxAtLeast 50, unit cm, cue 'to more than'). Write no OWL bound: a lower bound would claim every rhizome is longer than 50 cm, and an upper bound is false.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: Same table as P01842. French 'liane' = whole plant (PO:0000003) climbing (FLOPO:0991108) and woody, with the noun as the RDF cue. The table needs French and Spanish forms (liane, liana, bejuco, trepadora).

proposed: comparison between regions of one part
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: leaflet abaxial epidermis. Quality: increased colour brightness (PATO_0000665 'high brightness', child of colour brightness PATO_0000016), towards the leaflet adaxial epidermis. The bearer is substituted through the surface slot, and the target comes from the preceding 'adaxially' within the same leaflet clause. OWL as pattern 09 with towards; RDF flags the target as implied. A rule can also give the leaflet discolorous (FLOPO:0991070) when both sides are stated.

statement: Stems, leaves, peduncles and pedicels glabrous to scabrous, pubescent or subtomentose
family: nested alternatives
sketch: The list is a one_of over operands, the first of which is itself a continuum: (glabrous → scabrous FLOPO:0991058) or pubescent (PATO_0000455) or subtomentose (tomentose PATO_0002341, approximately). OWL takes the union of the operand values. The continuum is kept as a qualitative_value_relation in RDF. Distribute over stems, leaves, peduncles and pedicels.

family: dimension counted in cells
sketch: Bearer: the leaf border, limbidium (FLOPO_0986075). Quality: thickness (PATO_0000915), with a count of cell layers as the value (unit 'cell', low 3, high 4), not a length. OWL: thickness with a data range and a FLOPO cell count unit.

statement: celles du verticille supérieur à peine plus longues que celles du verticille inférieur
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: anther part of a stamen of the upper whorl (FLOPO upper FLOPO:0991376 on the whole, pattern 12). Quality: increased length towards an anther part of a stamen of the lower whorl (FLOPO:0991377). OWL as pattern 09 with a qualified target of the same PO class. 'à peine' (barely) is a degree qualifier and stays in RDF.

family: dimension counted in cells
sketch: Bearer: leaf margin (border) of the moss leaf. Quality: width, with a count of cell rows as the value (unit 'cell', low 1, high 2). OWL: width with a data range and a FLOPO cell count unit. '1-stratose' is unistratose (FLOPO:0991320) separately.

family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: RDF: fb:maxAtLeast 10 cm with the cue 'to more than' on the whole plant height. No OWL bound.

proposed: process at a stage of development
family: G before or after a stage
sketch: Slots: the part (leaf, proximal per pattern 18), the process (withering, then turning brown to blackish, then persisting) and the stage it is tied to ('before flowering'). Only the end state can go into OWL, as marcescent (FLOPO:0991181: withered but persisting). The process and timing stay in RDF until the 'before or after a stage' slot exists.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: Same table as P01842. 'woody climber' = whole plant climbing (FLOPO:0991108) and woody. 'Large' is vague and stays in RDF.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: Same table: liana = whole plant climbing (FLOPO:0991108) and woody. The following 'twining' is annotated separately (see P01870 for the missing value) and '25 m' as a length bound.

family: G before or after a stage
sketch: Slots: bearer, attribute, direction of change (increased length PATO:0000573), and the later stage with its cue ('in fruit', the fruiting stage of kind A). OWL: pedicel has characteristic 'increased length' and 'happens during' (RO:0002092) the fruit-development stage. The comparison with the same part at anthesis ('elongating') stays in RDF as fb:change 'elongating'.

family: other, one or two cases each
sketch: Bearer: the exuding part (here the whole plant or stem) has part some ('plant exudate' and has characteristic some yellowish-white), with gum as the kind of exudate. This needs a FLOPO anatomy class 'plant exudate' (gum, latex, resin), which PO lacks. The medicinal use ('ammoniacum ... used in medicine') is not annotated.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: Give the habit noun 'vine' an EQ signature: whole plant PO:0000003 has characteristic climbing FLOPO:0991108. Add 'vine' as a related synonym of climbing, used only when the noun is the subject of a habit sentence. 'Vines woody' adds ligneous PATO:0002348 as a second record.

statement: pourvues ou non de feuilles ± réduites
family: F optional part
sketch: Bearer: leaf (reduced) as part of the inflorescence, with operands present | absent held as one_of in RDF. '± réduites' is the approximate value reduced size of the leaves. OWL asserts nothing, because a union with a negation is outside EL.

statement: stamens equal to or twice the number of petals
family: counts relative to something
sketch: Slots: counted part (stamen), amount PATO:0000070, towards the reference part (petal), and count ratios as one_of {1, 2} with the cue. OWL: amount towards petal only, as pattern 10 keeps ratios in RDF. Value classes isostemonous/diplostemonous could later be defined from the ratio (pattern 17).

statement: inserted 0·1–0·5 mm. below the corolla mouth
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: the filament (bearer), the relation 'inserted into' PATO:0000624 towards the corolla tube, and a distance PATO:0000040 of 0.1–0.5 mm from the corolla mouth (landmark) with its unit. OWL as pattern 09 (towards the corolla). The distance goes in RDF (fb:low/fb:high plus the landmark), or as a data range on a distance quality towards the landmark.

family: other, one or two cases each
sketch: Slots: the organ (young branch), the exudate (plant sap PO_0025538, or a mucilage term if one is added), the exudate's quality (white), and the condition cue 'when broken'. OWL: has part some (branch and has part some (sap and has characteristic some white)). The cue 'when broken' stays in RDF as a condition, as in pattern 06.

statement: base fused to basal margins of column for 2-3 mm
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: lip base (region), fused with PATO:0000642 towards column (gynostemium), and the length of the fused zone, 2–3 mm, with its unit. OWL as pattern 09 (fused towards the column). The extent goes in RDF or as a data range on the length of the connate region.

proposed: comparison with an implicit second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Slots: the bearer (leaf lamina abaxial epidermis PO_0000049, from 'beneath'), a relational colour quality (paler: low saturation / high brightness), and the implied target, here the opposite surface (adaxial epidermis) taken from 'green above'. OWL as pattern 09, towards the target. RDF marks the target as implicit (fb:targetImplicit true).

statement: forming a thick band 2–3 cells wide
family: dimension counted in cells
sketch: Bearer: limbidium FLOPO_0986075 of the apical and dorsal laminae. Two records: width 2–3 and thickness PATO:0000915 2–3, both with the unit 'cell'. RDF keeps 'cells wide' and 'cells thick' as cues. OWL uses the attribute with a magnitude and a cell-count unit, or the statement stays a record only until such a unit exists.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: leaf with has position upper FLOPO:0991376 (pattern 18). Quality: decreased size PATO:0000587 towards a leaf, the lower or basal leaves described just before. OWL: has part some (leaf and has position some upper and has characteristic some (decreased size and towards some leaf)). RDF flags the target as implied, with the cue 'smaller'.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: Use a reviewed table of habit nouns with their EQ meaning: bejuco/liana/liane → whole plant PO:0000003, climbing FLOPO:0991108, and woody where the noun implies it. The FLOPO habit phenotype class then gets this EQ signature. The noun is the cue in RDF.

statement: A high climbing herbaceous or semi-woody climber
family: C growth-form noun
sketch: 'Climber' → whole plant climbing FLOPO:0991108 (habit-noun table). 'Herbaceous or semi-woody' is a separate alternative record (pattern 07): herbaceous PATO:0002352 or woody with value_qualifier approximately ('semi-'). 'High climbing' stays in RDF.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: 'Bejuco' → whole plant climbing FLOPO:0991108 (and woody) through the habit-noun table. 'A veces colgante' is a separate record: whole plant pendent PATO_0104035 with frequency 'sometimes'.

family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: Bearer: inflorescence PO:0009049 (male panicle, bearer state male, pattern 04), length PATO:0000122. RDF only: fb:maxLow 40 cm, exclusive, cue 'to more than'. No OWL data range, because the statement bounds the largest panicles, not every panicle.

family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: Whole plant PO:0000003 height PATO:0000119. RDF only: fb:maxLow 20 m, exclusive, cue 'to over'. No OWL data range. 'Trees' is a separate habit record.

family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: Whole plant height PATO:0000119. RDF only: fb:maxLow 1 m, exclusive, cue 'to over'. No OWL data range. 'Single-stemmed, leafy shrub' gives separate records.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: 'Liane' → whole plant PO:0000003, climbing FLOPO:0991108 and woody, through the habit-noun table. '≤ 10 m' is a pattern-02 height record.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: 'Vines' → whole plant PO:0000003, climbing FLOPO:0991108 (not woody, which 'suffrutescent' qualifies separately). 'To 2 m' is a pattern-02 length record.

family: G before or after a stage
sketch: Slots: bearer (leaf with has position basal FLOPO:0991002), quality senescent PATO_0001487, stage relation 'before', stage PO flowering stage, plus the cue. The RDF record gets fb:stageRelation and fb:stage. OWL keeps only the bearer and quality, or uses an RO temporal relation ('ends before') to the stage once the model has more than present_during.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: bearer (stamen), quality exserted PATO_0000623 towards the implicit enclosing part (corolla), and a length of the exserted portion, 12-13 mm. OWL: has part some (stamen and has characteristic some exserted). The projection length goes into the record as fb:low/fb:high on a 'projection length' quality.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Slots: bearer (leaf lamina abaxial epidermis via slot 1, 'beneath'), relative colour quality (lighter), towards the contrasted side (adaxial epidermis), taken from 'dark-green above' in the same clause. OWL: has characteristic some (lighter and towards some adaxial epidermis). The record keeps the contrast cue.

statement: Seed at center or slightly toward base of samara
family: E part present at a position
sketch: Slots: located part (seed), whole (samara/fruit), region of the whole (centre or base region, BSPO), with a union over the two regions. OWL: has part some (fruit and has part some (seed and part of some (central region or basal region)))). The record keeps the region cues.

statement: glabrescentes o fugaz y esparcidamente lepidotos apicalmente
family: nested alternatives
sketch: one_of operands, each with its own bearer_scope: (sepal, glabrescent FLOPO:0991052) or (sepal apical region, scaly PATO_0001804, sparse, fugacious). OWL: union of the two has-part expressions. The Spanish connective 'o' and the adverb 'apicalmente' are the cues.

family: E part present at a position
sketch: Slots: the part that is present (adventitious root), and the place on the bearer (stem node, PO:0020141). OWL: 'has part' some ('adventitious root' and 'attached to' some ('stem node' and 'part of' some stem)). RDF: the record has the bearer culm and fb:quality present, plus the place as a bearer-part restriction.

statement: stamens inserted 6-7 mm from the base of the corolla tube
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: the bearer and its relation (stamen 'inserted into' corolla tube, PATO:0000624, pattern 09), the landmark (base of the corolla tube), and the distance (6-7 mm). OWL: the pattern 09 expression; the distance stays in RDF as fb:low/fb:high with unit mm and a fb:fromLandmark link to the tube base, or as PATO distance (PATO:0000040) towards the landmark.

family: nested alternatives
sketch: Slots: the first value (oblong, PATO:0000946) and a second value that is itself a compound (oblong-lanceolate, between oblong and lanceolate PATO:0001877). Represent it as a continuum whose upper end is the midpoint of the oblong–lanceolate continuum. OWL: has characteristic some (oblong or lanceolate) as an over-approximation; the exact range stays in the RDF qualitative_value_relation.

family: other, one or two cases each
sketch: Slots: two or more adjacent layers (exocarp, mesocarp), one shared dimension (thickness), and the value. OWL: 'has part' some (exocarp or mesocarp) is not enough; state the thickness of the pericarp less the endocarp (no PO class), or keep it in RDF only with fb:bearer listing both parts and fb:combined true.

proposed: comparison between regions of one part
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Slots: the bearer, the region (margin), the comparison (paler), and the implied counterpart (the rest of the same part). OWL: 'has part' some (perigynium margin and 'has characteristic' some (lighter-colour quality and towards some (perigynium body))). The counterpart is named by rule, not from the text.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: the bearer, the value (decurrent PATO:0001984), the dimension of the region that has the value (length), and its range 5(-8) mm. OWL: 'has part' some (spine-shield and 'has characteristic' some decurrent). The length of the decurrent portion stays in RDF as fb:low/fb:high on a fb:extentOf link, or as a part-restriction region with length.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: the bearer (stamen), the relation exserted PATO:0000623 towards the reference part (corolla tube), and the length of the projecting portion. OWL: 'has part' some (stamen and 'has characteristic' some (exserted and towards some 'corolla tube')). The 1 mm projection stays in RDF as fb:low/fb:high with a fb:projectionBeyond link.

family: G before or after a stage
sketch: Slots: the process (fruit dehiscence) and its ordered phases (first apical, then retrorse along both sutures). OWL: only the stable part, fruit and 'has characteristic' some dehiscent (along the sutures). The order of phases stays in RDF as a sequence.

family: G before or after a stage
sketch: Slots: the event (flowering), the relation (before), and the reference stage (leaf emergence). OWL: whole plant 'has characteristic' some hysteranthous, a FLOPO value whose logical definition is flowering 'precedes' (BFO:0000063) leaf emergence. RDF: fb:stageRelation before, with the cue.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: As in P02067: stamen filament exserted PATO:0000623 towards the corolla (implied), with the projecting length 4-7 mm in RDF.

family: gradient along a series
sketch: Slots: the series (cauline leaves), the direction (base to apex), and the quality that changes (size, decreasing). OWL: no class beyond the members' own values; RDF: fb:gradient decreasing on size along the stem. The transcribed entity 'res' is garbled and should be 'cauline leaf'.

family: counts relative to something
sketch: Slots: bearer (inflorescence branch), division quality (dichotomous PATO:0001784, pinnate PATO:0000410), number of division orders (low, high, extremes) with a cue. OWL: has part some (bearer and has characteristic some (Q and has magnitude some xsd:decimal[>=2, <=3])) on a FLOPO 'order of division' attribute; RDF fb:divisionOrderLow/High. Where a term exists (bipinnate, tripinnate) the single order maps to it.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: bearer (corolla tube), relational quality exserted PATO:0000623 towards the enclosing part (calyx), and the length of the projecting portion (≤5 mm). OWL: has part some (corolla tube and has characteristic some (exserted and towards some calyx)); the length goes in RDF (fb:projectionLength, unit) or on a FLOPO 'exserted portion' part. The bearer is the corolla tube, not the corolla.

family: counts relative to something
sketch: Slots: bearer flower PO:0009046, a FLOPO merosity attribute (number of members in each floral whorl) with usual range 5-6 and max extreme 7 (pattern 05). OWL: has part some (flower and has characteristic some (merosity and has magnitude some xsd:decimal[>=5, <=6])); RDF as a count with fb:maxExtreme 7.

statement: primary bracts like the upper scape-bracts but narrower
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: bract with position primary (inflorescence-branch bract); decreased width PATO:0000599 towards bract with position upper on the scape. 'towards' must accept a positioned part (pattern 18) so that target ≠ bearer. 'like X' (similar in other respects) is kept as text only.

family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: 'to at least 35 cm' says the largest leaf is ≥35 cm. It does not bound every leaf. RDF only: fb:maxAtLeast 35, unit cm, with the cue; no OWL class (like pattern 14), because neither ≤35 nor ≥35 holds of every leaf.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer bracteole PO:0009043, decreased size towards bract PO:0009055, with the second term taken from the preceding clause of the same sentence and its offsets as cue. 'similar' is not annotated.

statement: basal and proximal usually withering by flowering
family: G before or after a stage
sketch: Slots: bearer (basal leaf FLOPO:0996000, proximal cauline leaf), state (withered), stage flowering PO:0007616, and stage relation 'by' (before or at). RDF fb:stageRelation 'by' with the cue and 'usually' as frequency. OWL: only present_during is defined, so it stays RDF until 'before/after' relations exist.

family: counts relative to something
sketch: Slots: counted part (tooth), container (leaf margin), count 5-9, reference length 2 cm. RDF: fb:perLength 2, unit cm (or normalised to 2.5-4.5 per cm). OWL: a FLOPO linear-density attribute with a data range, or none, as in pattern 14.

statement: lamina to at least 80 cm long
family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: As for 'Leaves to at least 35 cm': RDF fb:maxAtLeast 80 cm on the lamina length, with the cue; no OWL class.

family: counts relative to something
sketch: Leaf pinnate PATO:0000410 with division order 3-4 and max extreme 5 (pattern 05). OWL with a data range on the order-of-division attribute; a single order of 2 or 3 maps to bipinnate FLOPO:0991014 / tripinnate FLOPO:0991159.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: A habit noun becomes a conjunction of whole-plant qualities, not a class with no definition: liana = whole plant (PO:0000003) has characteristic climbing (FLOPO:0991108) and has part some (stem and has characteristic some woody). Two records from one cue, each with the noun as text. 'woody' needs a value class (only semi-woody FLOPO:0991309 exists).

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: 'Climbing shrub' = whole plant with climbing (FLOPO:0991108) plus the shrub habit (frutescent, FLOPO:0987002, given an EQ form: whole plant with woody, branched-from-base stems). The adjective already grounds; the noun needs its decomposition.

statement: of the previous season's growth brown and exfoliating
family: other, one or two cases each
sketch: The bearer is a shoot/twig of a given age in growing seasons ('previous season's growth' = second-year shoot). Store 'has age in seasons' 2 as the bearer state (RDF fb:bearerState with the cue). OWL: has part some (bark and part of some (stem and has characteristic some 'age in seasons'=2) and has characteristic some exfoliating).

family: counts relative to something
sketch: Flower has a merosity quality with 'has number of parts per whorl' 5 (extreme 7, pattern 05). OWL: has part some (flower and has characteristic some (merosity and 'has number of parts per whorl' value 5)). RDF: fb:low/fb:high with the count unit and the extremes.

family: E part present at a position
sketch: Presence of adventitious roots at the nodes: has part some (stem and has part some (shoot axis node PO:0005004 and 'attached to' some 'adventitious root')). RDF: bearer adventitious root, quality present, place node with its cue.

statement: margins with 3-7 low teeth per cm.
family: counts relative to something
sketch: A density of parts along a length: bearer leaf margin, quality linear density towards tooth, 3-7 per cm (unit count per centimetre). RDF only, like pattern 14 (fb:countPosition 'per_length'); no phenotype class, because it is not a count of the organ.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Anther exserted (PATO_0000623) plus a distance of 4 mm beyond the perianth: has characteristic some (distance PATO:0000040 towards perianth, 4 mm). RDF: fb:low/fb:high on the distance, with the exsertion cue.

family: E part present at a position
sketch: As P02148: adventitious root attached to the shoot axis node of the lower repent stem part (region proximal). Presence in OWL, place cue in RDF.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: A reviewed table maps a habit noun to whole plant PO:0000003 and one or more values. Liana maps to climbing FLOPO:0991108 and ligneous PATO:0002348. OWL: has part some (whole plant and has characteristic some climbing and has characteristic some ligneous), which is also the EQ for FLOPO:0900035 'whole plant lianescent'. RDF: one record per value with the noun as cue.

family: G before or after a stage
sketch: Record the rachis length PATO:0000122 with upper bound 10 mm and a stage relation {after, 'after mature scales and achenes have shed'} with its cue. The OWL class holds the length only and the stage relation stays in RDF, as for pattern 04/06 qualifiers.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: As for P02164: Liana maps to whole plant PO:0000003 + climbing FLOPO:0991108 + ligneous PATO:0002348, one RDF record per value, with the noun as cue.

proposed: presence or absence of a part at a place
family: E part present at a position
sketch: 'ramas desnudas en el 1/5-1/2 inferior' is absence (pattern 15) of spikelets PO:0009051 on the proximal region of the panicle branch. The extent (1/5-1/2) is kept in RDF as a region fraction. OWL: has part some (inflorescence branch and not has part spikelet in proximal region) cannot be stated in EL, so only the record is kept.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: A length PATO:0000122 of the split (or fused) portion of the bearer, with a slot for the kind (split from apex / fused from base) and its cue. RDF: fb:low/high of the divided portion; OWL: has part some (petal and has characteristic some split PATO:0001786), the depth staying in RDF.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Resolve 'similar' to the sibling in the preceding clause (abaxial calyx lobes) and store a relation 'similar towards abaxial lobe' with its cue in RDF only. Do not copy values into OWL, because the shared qualities are not stated.

statement: to at least 28 cm in dbh
family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: 'to at least 28 cm' says the largest trunks reach ≥ 28 cm: record stem PO:0009047 diameter PATO:0001334 with a maximum-at-least value and 'dbh' as a region cue (at breast height). There is no OWL class, because it does not bound every plant.

statement: dont les externes soudées sur 2 mm et les internes sur 3 mm
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Same pattern, in its fusion form: the outer stamens (pattern 18 outer) are fused with each other (PATO:0000642, pattern 16) over a length of 2 mm from the base, and the inner over 3 mm. RDF carries the fused length; OWL carries fused only.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: As for P02164: liana maps to whole plant + climbing FLOPO:0991108 + ligneous PATO:0002348. 'to 35 m' is a separate length upper bound (pattern 02) of the plant.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: the part (nectary PO:0009035), a length range with unit, the landmark (base of the corolla lobe) and its cue. RDF: a PATO distance PATO:0000040 measurement with fb:low/fb:high/fb:unit and the landmark. OWL: at most has part some (nectary and part of some corolla lobe), the presence only, like pattern 14.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: the part (stamen PO:0009029), exserted PATO:0000623 towards the perianth, and the length of the projecting portion (1-2 mm). OWL: has part some (stamen and has characteristic some (exserted and towards some perianth)). RDF: the projection length as fb:low/fb:high/fb:unit. The alternative 'not exserted or' stays a union (pattern 07).

proposed: count of the members with a quality
family: counts relative to something
sketch: Slots: the whole (androecium), the members (stamen), a quality of a subset (fused), and the size of the subset (9 of 10). OWL: has part some (stamen and has characteristic some (fused with and towards some stamen)), presence only. RDF: the subset count and the free member ('la vexillaire libre').

statement: basally covered with dark brown remains of old leaf sheaths
family: E part present at a position
sketch: Slots: the part (leaf sheath PO:0020104, in the state old/dead), the place (stem base PO:0008039), and qualities of the part (dark brown, persistent). OWL: has part some (leaf sheath and has characteristic some non-deciduous PATO:0001732 and part of some stem base). RDF: the place cue and 'remains'.

family: counts relative to something
sketch: Bearer: the whorl (involucre PO:0009100). OWL: multiseriate FLOPO:0991084, which holds for any count of 2 or more. RDF: the number of series 5-6 (unit count) with the counted item 'series', because pattern 03 does not split 'seriate'.

family: counts relative to something
sketch: As in P02234: move the bearer from bract to involucre PO:0009100, multiseriate FLOPO:0991084 in OWL, and the count 5 in RDF with 'environ' as approximately (pattern 01).

family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: 'to more than 1 m tall' says the largest plants exceed 1 m, not that every plant does. Slots: bearer, attribute (height PATO:0000119), a lower bound on the maximum (fb:maxAtLeast 1.0 m) and its cue. RDF only: a class 'height > 1 m' would be false for small or annual plants of the taxon.

family: counts relative to something
sketch: Four of the five petals share a shape and the fifth differs. Slots: bearer petal, value (one_of narrowly oblong-cuneate | obovate-cuneate), and the members it applies to (fb:memberCount 4, of a series of 5). A separate record covers the odd member (falcately dimidiate). OWL: 'has part some (petal and has characteristic some (...))' is true as stated; the 4-of-5 split stays in RDF.

family: nested alternatives
sketch: Two alternatives of pilosity in which one has its own region: hairy in the adaxial groove (canalicule) or glabrous. Slots: value_operands, each with its own part_restrictions (region). OWL: has part some (petiole and ((has part some (groove and has characteristic some hairy)) or has characteristic some glabrous)).

family: G before or after a stage
sketch: Slots: bearer (filament), attribute (length PATO:0000122), direction of change (increase), the stage (anthesis, a PO flowering stage) and the cue. RDF records the change. OWL gets no class: accrescent FLOPO:0991082 (rule R0446) means growth after flowering, which is a different stage.

proposed: comparison with an implicit second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: The apical and basal lamina cells are shorter than the other (median) cells of the same leaf (50–100 µm). Slots: bearer leaf cell with region apical/basal, decreased length PATO:0000574, and an implied target: the rest of the series, recorded as fb:comparedWith 'other laminal cells'. OWL only if the target is written as the same cell class of the median region; otherwise RDF only.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: bearer (alar region, a group of alar cells PO:0030057), landmark (costa PO:0030072), relation (reaching / not reaching / beyond), negation, and the cue. RDF records 'not reaching' with fb:negated. OWL only for a positive 'reaching', as a relational quality towards the landmark (no PATO 'extending to' class; 'in contact with' PATO:0001961 is weaker).

statement: sessile or with a peduncle up to 0.1 cm long
family: nested alternatives
sketch: A union of a value and a measurement of another part: the fig is sessile, or its peduncle is ≤ 0.1 cm long. Operands: (inflorescence, sessile) | (peduncle PO:0009053, length ≤ 0.1 cm), each with its cue. OWL: has part some (inflorescence and (has characteristic some sessile or has part some (peduncle and length[≤0.1 cm]))).

family: nested alternatives
sketch: Two habits, each with its own height: (whole plant, shrub habit, height 2 m) | (whole plant, tree habit, height 3.5–23 m). Operands are pairs of habit and height, with the habit grounded to frutescent/arborescent values on the whole plant. OWL: has characteristic some ((frutescent and height 2 m) or (arborescent and height[3.5, 23] m)), or RDF only until the habit classes have an EQ signature.

family: nested alternatives
sketch: Slots: an alternative (one_of) whose operands are a continuum (ovate–elliptic, a qualitative_value_relation) and a single value (oblong-elliptic, itself a hyphen continuum oblong–elliptic). OWL: the union of all end values of one shape attribute: has part some (leaf lamina and has characteristic some (ovate or elliptic or oblong)). RDF: one_of over operands, each operand keeping its own continuum relation.

statement: ventral sporophylls much smaller than dorsal leaves
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: sporophyll PO:0009026 with has position ventral; towards: sporophyll (or leaf) with has position dorsal; quality decreased size PATO:0000587. OWL: has part some (sporophyll and has position some ventral and has characteristic some (decreased size and towards some (sporophyll and has position some dorsal))). Pattern 09's comparison() currently refuses a target of the same class as the bearer; it must accept one when the position differs.

statement: upper cauline leaves sometimes ternate and smaller
proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: leaf with has position upper (and cauline); quality decreased size; implied target: the leaves of the complementary position in the same series (lower/basal leaves), recorded as fb:implicitTarget with the rule that supplied it. OWL: towards some (leaf and has position some lower) only when the series has exactly two named members; otherwise an RDF-only record. 'ternate' is a separate statement (FLOPO:0991286 ternately compound, frequency 'sometimes').

family: nested alternatives
sketch: Operands: pentagonal PATO:0040016, and pentagonal-ovate read as a hyphen continuum pentagonal–ovate PATO:0001891. OWL: has part some (leaf lamina and has characteristic some (pentagonal or ovate)); RDF: one_of whose second operand carries the continuum relation.

proposed: comparison between regions of one part
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: corolla tube; region: the strips along the adnate filaments (fb:regionText); quality: low brightness PATO:0000327 relative to the rest of the tube; frequency 'sometimes'. RDF only (fb:comparedWith 'rest of bearer'); no OWL class, because the colour of the reference region is given elsewhere ('pink to crimson').

family: F optional part
sketch: 'acaulescent or shortly caulescent': operands are stem absent (pattern 15, 'part of' form) and stem present with short length. OWL: 'phenotype of' some (not (has part some stem) or has part some (stem and has characteristic some decreased length)), which is not EL; RDF: one_of with a negated operand. The privative word 'acaulescent' is its own negation cue (as 'leafless').

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: As P02286: bearer leaf with has position cauline FLOPO:0991117; quality decreased size; implied target: the basal leaves of the same plant (fb:implicitTarget). OWL towards some (leaf and has position some basal) only when the series is basal/cauline. The count 1–2 is a separate statement.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: leaf lamina abaxial epidermis ('beneath', surface rule); quality: increased brightness, i.e. paler; implied target: the adaxial surface of the same leaf. OWL: has characteristic some (increased brightness and towards some leaf lamina adaxial epidermis); the target is set by rule for each surface word.

statement: anthers inserted 5–8(–10.5) cm above the base of tube
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: bearer anther (insertion point), PATO distance PATO:0000040, landmark base of the perianth tube, range 5–8 cm with extreme 10.5 (pattern 05). OWL: has part some (anther and has characteristic some (distance and towards some (base region and part of some perianth tube))) with the usual range as a data range; RDF fb:landmark plus low/high/max-extreme.

family: G before or after a stage
sketch: Bearer: ocrea (distal part); end state fibrous FLOPO:0991026 with bearer state mature/old; 'soon' is the timing (fb:timing, RDF only). OWL: has part some (ocrea and has characteristic some fibrous). Only the end state, without a start value, so the transition pattern ('white becoming pink') does not apply.

statement: prolonged 0–3 mm. beyond the lateral leaflets
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: the bearer, the part it projects beyond, and the length of the projecting piece. Here the bearer is leaf rachis PO:0020055 (not leaf), it projects beyond leaflet PO:0020049 with lateral position FLOPO:0991380, and the length is 0-3 mm. OWL: has part some (leaf rachis and has characteristic some (length and towards some leaflet)), possibly with a FLOPO 'projecting length' attribute. The numbers stay in RDF as fb:low/fb:high mm.

family: position of greatest width
sketch: A FLOPO value 'widest above the middle' (and 'below', 'at the middle') of leaf lamina PO:0020039, defined by a measure as in pattern 17. It subsumes obovate PATO:0001936. OWL: has part some (leaf lamina and has characteristic some 'widest above the middle').

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Petal PO:0009032 is connate FLOPO:0991067, and the fused region in the basal part has a length of 0.5 mm. OWL: has part some (petal and has characteristic some connate). The extent goes in RDF (fb:low/fb:high on the connate record) until a 'connate region' class exists.

family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: The largest petioles PO_0020038 exceed 5 cm: RDF fb:maxAtLeast 5 cm, with the cue 'to more than'. No OWL data range, because not every petiole is longer than 5 cm.

family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer: calyx lobe (sepal PO:0009031) with position outer FLOPO:0991379, count 2. Quality: decreased length PATO:0000574 towards the sepals of the same series that are not outer (the inner ones). OWL: has part some (sepal and has position some outer and has characteristic some (decreased length and towards some (sepal and has position some inner))).

statement: becoming shorter and narrower toward the margins
family: gradient along a series
sketch: Bearer: the lower lamina cells of the moss leaf, not the leaf itself. Quality: decreasing length and width towards the margin. RDF: fb:gradient 'decreasing', direction 'towards margin'. OWL at most: the marginal lower cells have decreased length and decreased width towards the median cells.

statement: may reach as deep as 8 inches (20 cm)
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: The rhizome is at a distance below the soil surface: usually 5-8 cm, maximum extreme 20 cm (pattern 05 for the extreme). RDF: a measurement of PATO distance (PATO:0000040) from the soil surface, not the rhizome's own depth PATO:0001595. It is environment-dependent, so it stays RDF only.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: Rule Q14 maps 'liana' to FLOPO_0900035 'whole plant lianescent', which has no entity–quality signature. A reviewed habit-noun table should give it one: whole plant PO:0000003 with climbing FLOPO:0991108 and ligneous PATO:0002348, since a liana is a woody climber (curator decision of 2026-09-18). OWL: has part some (whole plant and has characteristic some climbing and has characteristic some ligneous). The record keeps the noun as its cue.

family: C growth-form noun
sketch: Map the habit nouns through the reviewed habit table: climber → whole plant climbing FLOPO:0991108; trailing shrub → whole plant procumbent PATO:0002389 and ligneous PATO:0002348. Join the two with the union pattern (07): has characteristic some (climbing or (procumbent and ligneous)). Rule Q10 holds 'climber' as primitive class FLOPO_0985031 (curator decision of 2026-09-18) and must be given this signature.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: OWL keeps spine shield FLOPO_0986078 decurrent PATO:0001984. The record keeps the extent of the decurrent extension below the spines (2–8 mm, length) as a measurement of the feature the value word names, not of the whole spine shield, whose size (± 1.5 × 1.5 mm) is a separate record.

family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: The bearer is the distal leaf (pattern 18: leaf has position upper FLOPO:0991376). Its decreased size PATO:0000587 is stated towards the other members of the same series (the proximal and mid-stem leaves), which have the same PO class. OWL: has part some (leaf and has position some upper and has characteristic some ('decreased size' and towards some (leaf and has position some lower))). The record notes that the second term is implied. 'subsessile' is a separate record.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: OWL: the leaf has part a leaf abscission zone PO:0006501 (an articulation in the blade). The record gives the distance of that zone from the landmark, the lamina base PO:0008019: 0.3–0.4 cm, PATO distance PATO:0000040.

family: E part present at a position
sketch: Shoot-borne roots PO:0000042 are present at the stem nodes. OWL: has part some (stem and has part some (stem node PO:0020141 and 'attached to' some shoot-borne root)). The record keeps 'rooting at nodes' as its cue.

statement: stamens as many as perianth lobes
proposed: count equal to that of another part
family: counts relative to something
sketch: Record: the stamen count with the perianth lobe FLOPO_0986004 as reference and ratio 1, like pattern 10 for counts. OWL cannot attach a second towards to has number of PATO:0001555, whose towards is already the counted part, so the record has no class unless a number is derived. Here the number can be derived from '4–5-merous' in the same sentence: stamens 4–5.

family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: The bearer is the cauline leaf (pattern 18, cauline FLOPO:0991117). Decreased size PATO:0000587 towards the basal leaves of the same plant (leaf with position basal FLOPO:0991002), with the second term marked as implied by the description order. OWL as in the other comparisons within a series; the record keeps 'smaller'.

statement: like median stem leaves but smaller
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: The bearer is the upper leaf (position upper FLOPO:0991376). Decreased size PATO:0000587 towards the leaf with position median FLOPO:0991381, which is stated here ('median stem leaves'). 'like median stem leaves' (similar shape) stays in the source text.

statement: margins revolute to mid leaf or beyond
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Put leaf margin PO:0020128 revolute PATO:0001963 in OWL. Keep the extent in RDF: the region from the base up to at least the middle of the lamina (fb:extentToAtLeast 'middle', cue 'to mid leaf or beyond').

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer leaf lamina abaxial epidermis PO:0000049, with a relative lightness of colour towards (RO:0002503) the adaxial epidermis. A rule pairs the implied term with the cue ('beneath' implies above, 'inner' implies outer). OWL: has_characteristic some (lighter colour and towards some adaxial epidermis); the cue goes in RDF.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Bearer tendril, with the branch point at distance PATO:0000040 1-5 cm towards the tendril base (has magnitude, UO cm) in RDF. Put tendril branched in OWL, with the branch count 2-7 as in 'count of branches of a branched part'.

family: nested alternatives
sketch: Make one_of operands that are each a conjunction of values of one bearer: (green and striped and spotted with reddish brown) or (uniformly greenish yellow). OWL: has_characteristic some (A and B) or has_characteristic some C, with each operand's cues in RDF.

statement: with a taproot sometimes exceeding 16 feet (4.8 m)
family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: 'sometimes exceeding 16 feet' is a lower bound on the largest value, not an upper bound. Bearer primary root PO:0020127 (synonym tap root); quality length (depth). Keep it in RDF only, as value_max_extreme > 4.8 m with source_unit ft and the cue 'sometimes exceeding'; it adds no data range to OWL.

family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: 'to more than 1 m' says that the largest stems exceed 1 m. Store value_max_extreme > 1 m in RDF with the cue, and no data range in OWL. The quality of a climbing stem is length, not height.

proposed: measured extent of a positional quality
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: OWL: has part some (stamen filament and has characteristic some exserted PATO:0000623). RDF: the extent 1-2 mm as fb:low/fb:high with unit mm and the cue 'exserted', read as the distance the part projects beyond its reference (the perianth tube), towards that part.

statement: valves not retaining seeds after dehiscence
family: G before or after a stage
sketch: The bearer is the seed, and the quality is not retained by the valve after the fruit dehisces. OWL: seed part of fruit with deciduous (generic) PATO:0001730 towards the valve. RDF: an 'after' relation to the dehiscence stage with its cue. The model has only present_during.

proposed: measured extent of a positional quality
family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: OWL: has part some (nectary PO:0009035 and has characteristic some raised PATO:0001369). RDF: an extent of 0.5-1 mm with unit mm and the cue, plus towards ovary PO:0009062 ('on ovary apex'). The diameter 3-4 mm is an ordinary measurement.

family: E part present at a position
sketch: Express it as the presence of bristles on the branchlet alongside the prickles: has part some (branch and has part some bristle), with frequency 'often' in RDF and 'intermixed with' as cue. Bristle needs grounding (a FLOPO anatomy class, or trichome PO:0000282 if accepted).

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Bearer leaf lamina abaxial epidermis PO:0000049. Quality low saturation/pale PATO:0000328 towards the adaxial epidermis, the other surface named in the same sentence ('upper surface dark green'). The implied target and the cue 'paler' go in RDF; OWL uses towards.

family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: In RDF, record that the largest inflorescences exceed 15 cm (fb:maxAtLeast 15 cm, cue 'to >'). No OWL lower bound, because that would claim that every inflorescence is longer than 15 cm.

family: F optional part
sketch: Bracteole of the male inflorescence pedicel: in RDF, count 2 with position basal (pattern 18) and presence 'optional' (cue 'or absent'). No OWL class, because 'present or absent' says nothing about every plant, and the count holds only when the bracteoles are present.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Frond (vascular leaf PO:0009025): distance PATO:0000040 towards the same kind of part (towards frond), value ca. 0.5 cm with 'ca.' as approximately (pattern 01) and 'apart' as the cue. OWL: the distance quality with towards. The number stays in RDF like a measurement.

proposed: quality of a process of the part
family: other, one or two cases each
sketch: Bearer inflorescence (its flowers). The quality synchronous PATO:0000695 inheres in the flower-opening process in which the flowers take part. OWL: has part some (flower and participates in some (flower opening and has characteristic some synchronous)). RDF: the process and the cue 'opening simultaneously'.

family: counts relative to something
sketch: OWL: stem branched PATO:0000402. RDF: branching order with a lower bound of 2 (cue 'twice or more', fb:low 2, unit count). The order is not in the class, because it is a count of successive branchings and not of parts.

family: B lower bound on the maximum
sketch: In RDF, record that the largest stems exceed 40 cm (fb:maxAtLeast 40 cm, cue 'to more than'). No OWL bound.

proposed: comparison with an implied second term
family: A comparison with an implied counterpart
sketch: Slots: bearer with position (inner sepal), relative quality (decreased width PATO), and the implied second term taken from the previous clause of the same series (outer sepal). OWL: has part some (sepal and has position some inner and has characteristic some (decreased width and towards some sepal)). The target's position (outer) is kept in RDF only, because OWL cannot say 'the outer ones of the same flower'.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: Slots: bearer (stamen), relational quality exserted PATO:0000623 towards the enclosing part (corolla, from the clause), and the distance by which it protrudes (low/high/unit). OWL: has part some (stamen and has characteristic some (exserted and towards some corolla)). The 3–5 mm stays in RDF as a distance PATO:0000040 record with fb:towards.

family: D measured extent of a state or relation
sketch: As P02548: stamen filament exserted PATO:0000623 towards the perianth tube ('from the tube'), with the protrusion ± 5 mm as a distance record in RDF (approximately). OWL keeps only the exserted-towards expression.

family: counts relative to something
sketch: Slots: counted part (prickle PO:0025169), the axis it is counted on (container, from the clause: stem), low/high and a rate unit (count per dm, converted to per cm). No phenotype class, as in pattern 14. RDF: fb:bearer, fb:container, fb:low 1, fb:high 20, fb:unit for the rate, and the cue 'per decimetre'.
